unit.title: 八上 Unit 4
unit.subtitle: What Do You Want to Be in the Future?

points.label: 動詞＋to V（不定詞當受詞）

concepts.title: 動詞 + to V（不定詞當受詞）

blocks.text: 一個句子只能有一個主要動詞。want、need、hope、plan、decide、learn 後面的第二個動作要寫成 to + 原形動詞。

head: 句型
例子
rows: 主詞 + 動詞 + to V
I plan to be a lawyer.
主詞 + want / need / ask / teach + 人 + to V
Mom needs me to buy lunch.
否定：don't / doesn't / didn't + 原形動詞 + to V
叫人「不要」做：動詞 + 人 + not to V
Dad asked me not to watch TV.

items.en: Amy hopes to be a dentist in the future.
items.zh: Amy 希望將來當牙醫。

items.en: We decided to take a trip to Tainan.
items.zh: 我們決定去臺南旅行。

items.en: My uncle taught me to drive a truck.
items.zh: 我叔叔教我開卡車。

items.en: Kevin didn't plan to join the art club.
items.zh: Kevin 沒有計劃加入美術社。

items.wrong: She wants to goes home.
items.right: She wants to go home.
items.why: to 後面永遠是原形動詞；s 只加在主要動詞 want 上。

items.wrong: He doesn't wants to play.
items.right: He doesn't want to play.
items.why: doesn't 後面要用原形動詞 want。

items.wrong: Mom wants I to clean my room.
items.right: Mom wants me to clean my room.
items.why: 動詞後面的「人」是受詞，要用受格 me／him／her／us／them。

items.wrong: We decided to took a trip.
items.right: We decided to take a trip.
items.why: 過去式只變主要動詞 decided，to 後面還是原形。

items.wrong: I hope being a doctor.
items.right: I hope to be a doctor.
items.why: hope 只能接 to V，不能接 V-ing。

blocks.text: 這些動詞都是在說「還沒做、想去做」的事（想要、需要、希望、計劃、決定），所以用 to V 指向未來的動作。

concepts.title: 動詞 + V-ing（動名詞當受詞）

blocks.text: enjoy、keep、practice、finish 後面的動作只能用 V-ing，不可以用 to V。

head: 類別
動詞
例句
rows: I like to sing. = I like singing.

head: V-ing 拼字規則
例子
rows: 字尾 e：去 e 加 ing
短母音 + 一個子音：重複字尾加 ing
字尾 ie：改成 y 加 ing

items.en: Jason enjoys making videos.
items.zh: Jason 喜歡做影片。

items.en: Just keep practicing.
items.zh: 就持續練習吧。

items.en: Did you finish cleaning your room?
items.zh: 你打掃完房間了嗎？

items.en: Peter hates getting up early. = Peter hates to get up early.
items.zh: Peter 討厭早起。

items.wrong: I enjoy to read comic books.
items.right: I enjoy reading comic books.
items.why: enjoy 只能接 V-ing。

items.wrong: She finished to do her homework.
items.right: She finished doing her homework.
items.why: finish 只能接 V-ing。

items.wrong: He kept talk in class.
items.right: He kept talking in class.
items.why: keep 後面不能接原形，要用 V-ing。

items.wrong: Tom likes play basketball.
items.right: Tom likes to play basketball. / Tom likes playing basketball.
items.why: like 後面用 to V 或 V-ing 都可以，就是不能用原形。

items.wrong: She practices swiming every day.
items.right: She practices swimming every day.
items.why: swim 要重複字尾 m 再加 ing。

blocks.text: 口訣：「享受（enjoy）持續（keep）練習（practice）到完成（finish）」這四個只接 V-ing；「喜歡（like）愛（love）恨（hate）開始（start）」兩種都可以。
介系詞（at、for、about、of、by、before、after…）後面如果要接動作，一定用 V-ing，不可以用原形或 to V。

head: 常考片語
意思
rows: be bad / poor / terrible at + V-ing
think about / talk about / worry about + V-ing

items.en: You're really good at singing.
items.zh: 你真的很會唱歌。

items.en: Amy is thinking about joining the dance club.
items.zh: Amy 正在考慮加入舞蹈社。

items.en: Linda dreams of being a reporter.
items.zh: Linda 夢想成為記者。

items.en: Tom brushed his teeth before going to bed.
items.zh: Tom 睡覺前刷了牙。

items.en: He makes money by delivering newspapers.
items.zh: 他靠送報紙賺錢。

items.wrong: She is good at draw.
items.right: She is good at drawing.
items.why: at 是介系詞，後面要用 V-ing。

items.wrong: I'm thinking about to join the club.
items.right: I'm thinking about joining the club.
items.why: 介系詞後面不能接 to V。

items.wrong: He dreams of be a singer.
items.right: He dreams of being a singer.
items.why: be 動詞放在介系詞後面要寫成 being。

items.wrong: I'm sorry for broke your cup.
items.right: I'm sorry for breaking your cup.
items.why: 就算是過去的事，介系詞後面還是用 V-ing，不用過去式。

items.wrong: They worry about don't have money.
items.right: They worry about not having money.
items.why: V-ing 的否定是在前面加 not：not having。

blocks.text: 看到 be 動詞 + V-ing 先別急著當進行式：He is good at singing. 的 singing 是跟著介系詞 at 的動名詞。判斷方法是看 V-ing 前面那個字是不是介系詞。
動作要當主詞時，不能用原形動詞，要改成動名詞 V-ing（最常用）或不定詞 To V。一個動名詞片語算「一件事」，動詞用單數。

head: 主詞
動詞
例句
rows: To be a great soldier is my dream.

items.en: Eating breakfast is important.
items.zh: 吃早餐很重要。

items.en: Being a singer is my dream job.
items.zh: 當歌手是我夢想的工作。

items.en: Driving a truck takes a lot of practice.
items.zh: 開卡車需要很多練習。

items.en: Riding a bike and playing basketball are my favorite sports.
items.zh: 騎腳踏車和打籃球是我最喜歡的運動。

items.wrong: Collecting stamps are my hobby.
items.right: Collecting stamps is my hobby.
items.why: 主詞是「收集」這件事，不是 stamps；動名詞當主詞用單數。

items.wrong: Play basketball is fun.
items.right: Playing basketball is fun.
items.why: 原形動詞不能當主詞，要改成 V-ing 或 To V。

items.wrong: Be a teacher is not easy.
items.right: Being a teacher is not easy.
items.why: be 動詞當主詞要寫成 Being（或 To be）。

items.wrong: Swimming and jogging is good sports.
items.right: Swimming and jogging are good sports.
items.why: 兩個動名詞用 and 連接是兩件事，用複數動詞。

blocks.text: 找動詞單複數時，把動名詞後面的受詞先遮起來：Reading (comic books) is fun. 看到的主詞是 Reading，就不會被複數名詞騙到。
主詞太長時，先用 It 佔住主詞的位置，把真正的主詞 to V 放到句尾：It + is／was + 形容詞／名詞（+ for 人）+ to V。

head: 寫法
例句
rows: It is fun to read comic books.
To read comic books is fun.

items.en: It's great to have a dream.
items.zh: 有夢想很棒。

items.en: It is difficult for me to get up early.
items.zh: 對我來說早起很困難。

items.en: It was not a good idea to go out in the rain.
items.zh: 下雨天出門不是個好主意。

items.en: Is it easy for you to make new friends?
items.zh: 交新朋友對你來說容易嗎？

items.wrong: It is fun play video games.
items.right: It is fun to play video games.
items.why: 形容詞後面的真主詞要用 to V，不能用原形。

items.wrong: It is easy for she to make friends.
items.right: It is easy for her to make friends.
items.why: for 後面的人要用受格。

items.wrong: It is important to exercising every day.
items.right: It is important to exercise every day.
items.why: to 後面接原形動詞。

items.wrong: It is hard to speak English for me.
items.right: It is hard for me to speak English.
items.why: 「for 人」要放在形容詞和 to V 的中間。

items.wrong: It were fun to fly kites.
items.right: It was fun to fly kites.
items.why: 主詞是 It，be 動詞永遠用單數 is／was。

blocks.text: 互換三步驟：(1) 把句首的 V-ing 片語搬到句尾並改成 to V；(2) 句首補上 It；(3) be 動詞和形容詞照抄。反過來改也一樣。

passages.title: My Dream Job
passages.text:
My name is Peter, and I am in the eighth grade. I love animals, so I hope {{1}} an animal doctor in the future.

My cousin Lisa is an animal doctor. Last Sunday, I visited her at work. She was {{2}} care of a sick dog when I got there. She told me, "Helping sick animals {{3}} not easy, but I enjoy {{4}} this job."

Now I know my dream takes hard work. I am not good at science, {{5}} I don't want to give up. I plan to study hard and read some books about animals. It is important for me to keep trying.

passages.title: Before the Show
passages.text:
Tom: You look nervous, Amy. What's wrong?
Amy: I need {{1}} in front of the whole school tomorrow. I always get butterflies in my stomach {{2}} people watch me.
Tom: But you are really good at {{3}}. Everyone in our class loves your voice.
Amy: Thanks, but I'm worried about forgetting the words.
Tom: Don't worry. Just {{4}} practicing. It is helpful {{5}} the song in front of your family first.
Amy: Good idea! I can sing for my parents after dinner tonight.
Tom: See? You can do it. I believe in you.

passages.title: Uncle Ben's New Career
passages.text:
My uncle Ben worked in a shoe factory for ten years. He made good money there, {{1}} he was not happy. He dreamed of {{2}} his own vegetables. Two years ago, he decided {{3}} up his job and become a farmer. Some relatives made fun of his idea. "{{4}} a farmer is hard work," they said. However, Uncle Ben did not listen to them.

Now he grows tomatoes and sells them on the Internet. He gets up at five every morning, and he keeps {{5}} until the sun goes down. It is not easy to be a farmer, but he really enjoys his new career. I am proud of him.

passages.title: Ms. Lin, a Mail Carrier
passages.text:
Ms. Lin is a mail carrier in a small town. Every morning, she puts {{1}} her green jacket and rides her scooter from house to house. Delivering letters on rainy days {{2}} hard, but she never thinks about {{3}} her job. "I enjoy meeting people," she says. "Many old people here live alone, so it is important for them {{4}} someone to talk to."

Last month, a reporter interviewed Ms. Lin for a TV show. After the show, people all over the country wrote letters to thank her. Ms. Lin was very happy. She plans {{5}} working until she is sixty-five.

passages.title: Kevin's Auditions
passages.text:
Kevin loves acting. In the seventh grade, he acted in a school play for the first time and decided to become an actor. His classmates {{1}} fun of his dream, but he did not care.

Last year, Kevin went to ten auditions, but no one wanted him. He was sad, and he thought about {{2}} up. His mother said, "It takes time {{3}} successful. You need to believe in yourself." So Kevin kept {{4}} every day after school. He also learned to sing and dance.

{{5}}, a TV company called him last week. He got a part（角色） in a new show! Kevin learned an important thing: never give up your dream.

passages.title: Mr. Chen's Bread Shop
passages.text:
Mr. Chen is a successful baker（麵包師傅） in my town. People wait in a long line outside his shop every morning. However, his career did not start well.

Mr. Chen grew up in a poor family. After junior high school, he needed to make money, so he started working in a bread factory. He enjoyed making bread, and he dreamed of having his own shop one day. His relatives made fun of him. "Opening a shop takes a lot of money," they said. "Just keep your job at the factory."

Mr. Chen did not give up. He saved money for ten years and opened a small shop. At first, few people came, and he worried about losing everything. He decided to try new ideas. He kept making different kinds of bread and asked people to try them for free. Finally, people fell in love with his bread.

Now Mr. Chen teaches young people to bake. "It is important to follow your dream and never give up," he always tells them.

passages.title: An Interview with a Truck Driver
passages.text:
(Lisa is a reporter for her school newspaper. She is interviewing Ms. Wu, a truck driver.)

Lisa: Thank you for talking with me, Ms. Wu. Why did you decide to become a truck driver?
Ms. Wu: I love driving, and I enjoy seeing different places. My father was a truck driver, too. He taught me to drive.
Lisa: Is it difficult to be a truck driver?
Ms. Wu: Yes, it is. I often drive at night, so staying awake（清醒的） is the hard part. I keep singing to stay awake! Also, I'm away from home four days a week. I miss my kids a lot.
Lisa: Did people say anything when you started this job?
Ms. Wu: Some people made fun of me. They said, "Driving a truck is a man's job." But I didn't care about that. Now I'm a very successful driver in my company.
Lisa: What do you plan to do in the future?
Ms. Wu: I hope to have my own truck company one day. I want to give other women the chance to do this job.
Lisa: Good for you! Thank you, Ms. Wu.

passages.title: Join the Student Reporter Club!
passages.text:
Join the Student Reporter Club!

Do you enjoy writing? Are you good at talking to people? Do you dream of being on TV one day? Come and join us!

What do we do?
- We interview teachers, students, and people with interesting jobs. Last month, we talked to a soldier, a dentist, and a fisherman.
- We write stories for the school newspaper every month.
- We make videos for the school's YouTube channel.

Who can join?
- Students in the seventh and eighth grades
- You don't need to be good at writing now. The important thing is to be interested in people and to keep learning.

When and where?
- Every Wednesday, 4:10 p.m. to 5:30 p.m., in Room 302

How to join?
- Fill out the form（表格） and give it to Ms. Lin, the club teacher, before September 20.
- There is a short interview on September 23. Don't worry about it! We just want to know you.

We can only take fifteen new members this year, so don't wait!

passages.title: My Diary: The Class Show
passages.text:
Friday, November 20

Today was a big day for me. Our class had a show, and I needed to play the violin in front of everyone.

I practiced for a month, but I still had butterflies in my stomach this morning. I couldn't eat breakfast. At school, my hands were shaking（發抖） when I was waiting for my turn. I even thought about telling Ms. Wang, "I'm sick."

Then my best friend Judy came to me. "Being nervous is OK," she said. "Close your eyes and take three deep breaths（深呼吸） before going on stage. Don't look at everyone. Just look at me." I decided to try it.

It worked! When I started playing, I only looked at Judy. She was smiling at me the whole time. After I finished playing the song, everyone clapped（鼓掌） for me. Ms. Wang said, "That was beautiful!"

I learned something today. It is OK to be nervous, and it is great to have a good friend. I plan to join the school music contest next month!

passages.title: An Email to Grandma
passages.text:
Dear Grandma,

How are you? I want to tell you about Career Day at my school last Friday. Four people came to talk about their jobs.

The first speaker was a soldier. He gets up at five every day and exercises a lot. Keeping the country safe is important, but I am bad at getting up early! Next, a secretary told us about her day. She plans everything for her boss and answers about fifty phone calls a day. Then a salesman taught us to sell things. "Listening to people is the first step," he said. That surprised me. I thought salesmen just needed to talk a lot.

My favorite speaker was the last one, a farmer. She grows fruit without using anything bad for the land. She let us try her strawberries, and they were so sweet! After listening to her, I decided to grow some vegetables at home. Can you teach me to do that when I visit you next month? You are so good at growing things!

Love,
Emma

items.prompt: Kevin {{1}} to get a new bike for his birthday, but he is not sure about it.
items.explain: hope 是「希望」，後面接 to V（hope to get）。主詞 Kevin 是第三人稱單數，而且後半句 is 是現在式，所以要加 s 變成 hopes。只寫 hope 是忘了主詞動詞一致。

items.prompt: Do you have any plans for the {{1}}? What do you want to be in ten years?
items.explain: 後一句問「十年後你想當什麼」，可以推出前面在問「對未來的計畫」。in the future / for the future 是固定用法，future 前面要有 the。

items.prompt: We {{1}} to visit Grandma last weekend, but we stayed home because of the rain.
items.explain: plan to V 是「計劃做某事」。句中有 last weekend，後面的 stayed 也是過去式，所以要用過去式。plan 是「短母音＋單子音」結尾，要重複 n 再加 ed，寫成 planed 是常見錯誤。

items.prompt: My aunt is a {{1}}. She helps people fight for their rights.
items.explain: 線索是 fight for their rights（為他們的權利奮鬥），做這件事的職業是律師 lawyer。注意拼字是 law + yer，不要寫成 lawer。

items.prompt: My uncle doesn't have a {{1}} now, so he stays home and looks for work on the Internet.
items.explain: 後面說他待在家、上網找工作，可以推出他現在「沒有工作」。job 是可數名詞，所以前面有 a；work 當「工作」時不可數，不能說 a work。

items.prompt: I always get {{1}} in my stomach before a big test. I can't even eat breakfast.
items.explain: get butterflies in one's stomach 是「感到緊張」的慣用語，字面是「胃裡有蝴蝶」。butterfly 在這個片語裡一定用複數，字尾 y 要改成 i 再加 es。

items.prompt: Mom always {{1}} about my little brother when he comes home late.
items.explain: worry about 是「擔心…」。主詞 Mom 是第三人稱單數，always 表示習慣，用現在簡單式；worry 是「子音＋y」結尾，要去 y 加 ies。寫成 worrys 或 worry 都不對。

items.prompt: The baby {{1}} crying all night, so we didn't sleep well.
items.explain: keep + V-ing 是「持續做某事」，線索是後面的 crying。後半句 didn't sleep 是過去式，所以 keep 要用過去式；keep 是不規則動詞，過去式是 kept，不是 keeped。

items.prompt:
A: Let's have a picnic this Sunday.
B: Good {{1}}! The weather is nice these days.
items.explain: 對方提議去野餐，回答「好主意！」就是 Good idea!，是 That's a good idea. 的簡短說法。這是本單元對話的常用句，要整句記起來。

items.prompt: The lawyer fights for the {{1}} of poor people.
items.explain: fight for the rights of… 是「為…的權利奮鬥」。right 當「權利」是可數名詞，窮人的權利不只一項，所以用複數 rights。不要和形容詞 right（對的、右邊的）搞混。

items.prompt: It's cold outside. {{1}} on your jacket before you go out.
items.explain: put on 是「穿上」，線索是 cold 和 jacket。這是祈使句，動詞用原形並放句首，所以第一個字母要大寫。「穿上」的動作用 put on，不是 wear on。

items.prompt: The {{1}} asked the singer many questions and wrote a story for the newspaper.
items.explain: 問歌手很多問題、又替報紙寫報導的人是「記者」reporter。這個字是 report（報導）加 er 變成「做這件事的人」。

items.prompt: The reporter {{1}} the baseball player after the game yesterday.
items.explain: 記者對球員做的事是「採訪」interview。句尾有 yesterday，所以要用過去式，規則動詞直接加 ed。這個字很長，注意拼字是 inter + view。

items.prompt: My uncle is a mail {{1}}. He rides his scooter around town with a big bag of letters.
items.explain: 帶著一大袋信到處跑的人是「郵差」mail carrier。carrier 是 carry（攜帶）去 y 加 ier 變成「運送的人」，中間有兩個 r。

items.prompt: Amy has a bad tooth, so she is going to see the {{1}} this afternoon.
items.explain: 線索是 a bad tooth（蛀牙），牙齒有問題要看「牙醫」dentist。看醫生的動詞用 see，see the dentist 就是「去看牙醫」。

items.prompt: There are two shoe {{1}} in this town. Many people work there and make shoes.
items.explain: 很多人在那裡工作、製造鞋子的地方是「工廠」factory。前面有 There are two，所以要用複數；factory 是「子音＋y」結尾，去 y 加 ies。寫成 factorys 是常見錯誤。

items.prompt: The {{1}} goes out to sea in his boat and catches fish every day.
items.explain: 每天坐船出海捕魚的人是「漁夫」fisherman。動詞 goes 是單數，所以用單數 fisherman；複數是 fishermen。

items.prompt: Ms. Lin's {{1}} answers the phone and plans the day for her.
items.explain: 幫老闆接電話、安排一天行程的人是「祕書」secretary。這個字容易拼錯，可以拆成 se-cre-ta-ry 來記。

items.prompt: Everyone in the office is afraid of the {{1}}. He gets angry when people are late for work.
items.explain: 辦公室裡大家都怕、員工遲到會生氣的人是「老闆」boss。注意字尾是兩個 s。

items.prompt: The {{1}} sold ten cars this month. He is really good at talking to people.
items.explain: 這個月賣了十輛車、又很會跟人說話的是「銷售員」salesman。這個字是 sales + man，中間的 s 不要漏掉；複數是 salesmen。

items.prompt: Many {{1}} in this town grow rice and vegetables.
items.explain: 種稻米和蔬菜的人是「農夫」farmer。前面有 Many，後面動詞 grow 沒有加 s，可見主詞是複數，所以要寫 farmers。只寫 farmer 就錯了。

items.prompt: My grandpa {{1}} tomatoes in his garden last year, and they were sweet.
items.explain: 在菜園裡「種」番茄用 grow。句中有 last year，後面的 were 也是過去式，所以要用過去式；grow 是不規則動詞，過去式是 grew，不是 growed。

items.prompt: The {{1}} is fighting for his country far away from home.
items.explain: 離家很遠、為國家作戰的人是「士兵」soldier。注意拼字 sol-dier，中間的 d 發音像 [dʒ]，不要照發音亂拼。

items.prompt: Japan and Korea are two {{1}} near Taiwan.
items.explain: 日本和韓國是兩個「國家」country。前面有 two，所以要用複數；country 是「子音＋y」結尾，去 y 加 ies。寫成 countrys 是常見錯誤。

items.prompt: Mr. Chen is a {{1}} driver. He carries heavy things from city to city on the road.
items.explain: 在各城市之間載運重物的司機是「卡車司機」truck driver。計程車 taxi 載的是人不是重物，而且字尾也不合。

items.prompt: Dad {{1}} us to the beach yesterday, and it took two hours.
items.explain: drive + 人 + to + 地點 是「開車載某人去某地」。句中有 yesterday，後面 took 也是過去式，所以要用過去式；drive 是不規則動詞，過去式是 drove，不是 drived。

items.prompt: After years of hard work, she became a {{1}} writer. People all over the world read her books.
items.explain: 努力多年、全世界都讀她的書，表示她成為一位「成功的」作家。空格在名詞 writer 前面，要用形容詞 successful；success 是名詞，不能放在這裡。

items.prompt: I looked for my keys everywhere and finally {{1}} them under the sofa.
items.explain: look for 是「尋找」的過程，find 是「找到」的結果。前面的 looked 是過去式，and 連接的動詞時態要一致；find 的過去式是 found，不是 finded。

items.prompt: My sister is ten years old. She is in the fourth {{1}} this year.
items.explain: 十歲大約是小學四年級，in the fourth grade 就是「讀四年級」。「幾年級」要用序數（fourth、seventh、eighth）加 grade。

items.prompt: After thinking for a week, Tom {{1}} to join the baseball team.
items.explain: 想了一個星期之後「決定」加入棒球隊，decide 後面接 to V。這是一件已經發生的事，用過去式；decide 字尾已經有 e，只加 d。

items.prompt: Jay practiced the piano for years and finally {{1}} a famous musician.
items.explain: 練了很多年之後「成為」有名的音樂家，用 become。前面的 practiced 是過去式，and 後面的動詞時態要一致；become 的過去式是 became。這題最容易直接寫原形 become。

items.prompt: All my {{1}}, like my uncles, aunts and cousins, come to my house on Chinese New Year.
items.explain: 叔叔、阿姨、堂表兄弟姊妹都是「親戚」relative。前面有 All，後面動詞 come 沒有加 s，所以要用複數 relatives。

items.prompt: Don't {{1}} everything on the Internet. Some of it is not true.
items.explain: 後一句說「有些不是真的」，所以是「不要相信」網路上的每件事。Don't 後面接原形動詞。拼字注意是 ie，不是 ei。

items.prompt: Emma loves to {{1}}. She was the queen in the school play last year.
items.explain: 她去年在學校的戲裡演皇后，可見她喜歡「表演、演戲」act。love to 後面接原形動詞。

items.prompt: This singer is very popular. She has fans all {{1}} the world.
items.explain: all over the world 是「遍及全世界」，也可以說 all around the world。前一句說她很受歡迎，所以世界各地都有粉絲。

items.prompt: It's not nice to make {{1}} of other people's dreams.
items.explain: make fun of 是「取笑、嘲笑」。句意是「取笑別人的夢想並不好」。注意這個片語用的是名詞 fun，不是形容詞 funny。

items.prompt: The math problem was hard, but Kevin didn't {{1}} up. He kept trying and finally got the answer.
items.explain: give up 是「放棄」。後一句說他一直嘗試、最後算出答案，所以是「沒有放棄」。didn't 後面要接原形動詞，不可以寫 gave。

items.prompt: This YouTuber's {{1}} has many funny cooking videos. I watch it every day.
items.explain: YouTuber 放影片的地方是他的「頻道」channel，電視頻道也是同一個字。拼字注意中間有兩個 n。

items.prompt: The actor has short hair, so he wears a long {{1}} to play an old woman.
items.explain: 演員是短髮，要演老太太所以戴上長的「假髮」wig。線索是 short hair 和 wears。

items.prompt: After twenty years as a teacher, Ms. Wu started a new {{1}} as a writer.
items.explain: career 是「職業、生涯」，指長期從事的工作。她當了二十年老師之後，開始了作家的新職業生涯。拼字注意是兩個 e：ca-reer。

items.prompt: The mail carrier {{1}} letters and packages to our house every day.
items.explain: 郵差的工作是「投遞」信件和包裹，用 deliver。主詞 The mail carrier 是第三人稱單數，every day 表示習慣，所以現在式要加 s。

items.prompt: The school fair was a big {{1}}. Everyone had a great time, and we made a lot of money.
items.explain: 大家玩得開心又賺到錢，表示園遊會「很成功」。a big 後面要接名詞，所以用 success；successful 是形容詞，不能放在 a big 後面。

items.prompt: Hundreds of young singers went to the {{1}} for the TV show, but only ten of them got on the show.
items.explain: 很多年輕歌手去參加、最後只有十個人能上節目，這種選拔就是「試鏡」audition。字尾 -tion 是常見的名詞字尾。

items.prompt: Amy wants ___ the piano every day because she hopes to be a musician.
items.explain: 這題有兩個規則：want 後面接 to V，practice 後面接 V-ing。所以是 wants to practice playing。最常見的錯是看到 want 就把後面兩個動詞都寫成 to V（to practice to play），忘了 practice 自己要接動名詞。

items.prompt: My parents want ___ computer games and start doing my homework.
items.explain: want + 人（受格）+ to V 是「要某人做某事」，所以是 want me to stop，不能用主格 I，也不能漏掉 to。「停止正在做的事」用 stop + V-ing，所以是 stop playing；stop to play 是「停下來去玩」，和後面的「開始寫功課」意思相反。

items.prompt: Tom finished ___ his room and decided ___ a break.
items.explain: finish 後面只能接 V-ing（finished cleaning），decide 後面只能接 to V（decided to take）。兩個動詞的規則剛好相反，要分開判斷。選「to clean; taking」就是把兩個規則記反了。

items.prompt: Lisa was enjoying ___ to music when her mother asked her ___ the dishes.
items.explain: enjoy 不管是什麼時態，後面都接 V-ing，所以 was enjoying listening 雖然連續兩個 -ing 還是對的。ask + 人 + to V 是「要求某人做某事」，所以是 asked her to do。不要因為前面已經有 enjoying 就不敢再用 listening。

items.prompt: Kevin is good at ___ stories, and he plans ___ a writer.
items.explain: at 是介系詞，介系詞後面的動詞要用 V-ing，所以是 good at writing。plan 後面接 to V，所以是 plans to be。常見的錯是把 at 後面寫成 to write，或是把 plan 後面也跟著寫成 being。

items.prompt: Before ___ to bed, Jenny needs ___ her teeth.
items.explain: Before 在這裡是介系詞，後面沒有主詞，動詞要用 V-ing（Before going to bed）。need 後面接 to V（needs to brush）。選「going; brushing」是把兩格都寫成 V-ing，忘了 need 要接不定詞。

items.prompt: Making videos ___ a lot of time, but Zac enjoys ___ it.
items.explain: 主詞是 Making videos「做影片這件事」，動名詞當主詞視為單數，動詞要用 takes。不要被動詞前面的複數名詞 videos 騙了。後面 enjoy 接 V-ing，所以是 enjoys doing。

items.prompt: Being a soldier ___ easy, but my brother never thinks about ___ up.
items.explain: Being a soldier 是動名詞當主詞，視為單數，後面接形容詞 easy 要用 be 動詞，所以是 isn't。think about 的 about 是介系詞，後面接 V-ing，所以是 giving up。選 doesn't 是沒注意到 easy 是形容詞。

items.prompt: It is not easy ___ to finish ___ the report in one day.
items.explain: 句型是 It is + 形容詞 + for 人 + to V。easy 是在說「事情」容易不容易，要用 for me；of 只用在形容「人的個性」的形容詞（kind、nice）。真主詞裡的 finish 後面要接 V-ing，所以是 to finish writing。

items.prompt: Is ___ difficult for you ___ English in front of the class?
items.explain: 這是虛主詞句型的問句：把 It is difficult for you to speak… 的 is 移到句首。虛主詞只能用 it，不能用 that 或 this；真正的主詞是後面的 to V，所以是 to speak。看到 for you 後面就寫 speaking 是常見的錯。

items.prompt:
A: What does your father do?
B: ___
options: He does his best every day.
items.explain: What does + 人 + do? 是在問「職業」，要回答他是做什麼工作的。「He's doing the dishes now.」是回答 What is he doing?（現在正在做什麼）；「He's fine.」是回答 How is he?。這題最容易把現在簡單式和現在進行式的問句搞混。

items.prompt:
A: What do you want to be in the future?
B: ___
A: Good for you! You're really good at drawing.
options: I want to be at home tonight.
I hope to become an artist one day.
I want a new bike for my birthday.
I wanted to be a lawyer last year.
items.answer: I hope to become an artist one day.
items.explain: 問句 What do you want to be in the future? 問的是「未來想當什麼」，要回答職業，可以用 want to be / hope to become / plan to be。第三句 A 說「你很會畫畫」，所以答案是畫家。其他選項不是在講未來的職業，就是時間不對（tonight、last year）。

items.prompt:
A: I have a job interview tomorrow, and I have butterflies in my stomach.
B: ___
options: Take it easy. You can do it.
Wow! Where did you catch them?
Good for you! Go see a dentist.
items.answer: Take it easy. You can do it.
items.explain: have butterflies in one's stomach 是「很緊張」，不是真的有蝴蝶，也不是肚子餓或肚子痛。對方說明天要面試很緊張，要回答安慰、鼓勵的話：Take it easy.（放輕鬆）。照字面理解成蝴蝶或肚子的選項都是陷阱。

items.prompt:
A: ___
B: I enjoy playing the guitar and writing songs.
options: What do you want to be in the future?
What do you enjoy doing in your free time?
items.answer: What do you enjoy doing in your free time?
items.explain: 回答用 I enjoy + V-ing 說自己「喜歡做的事」，所以問句是在問興趣。「What are you doing now?」要用現在進行式 I'm playing… 回答；「What do you want to be…?」要回答職業；「What does your sister do?」問的是姊姊的工作，主詞也不對。

items.prompt:
A: Why do you want to be a dentist?
B: ___
options: Yes, I plan to be a dentist.
I see the dentist twice a year.
Because I want to help people with their teeth.
items.answer: Because I want to help people with their teeth.
items.explain: Why 問的是「原因」，要用 Because… 回答。Why 開頭的問句不能用 Yes / No 回答；「By studying…」是回答 How（用什麼方法）；「I see the dentist twice a year.」是回答多久看一次牙醫。

items.prompt:
A: I went to five auditions, but no one wanted me. Maybe acting is not for me.
B: ___
options: Don't give up. It takes time to be successful.
Good for you! You're a successful actor now.
Sure. Let's make fun of them.
I enjoy watching you on TV, too.
items.answer: Don't give up. It takes time to be successful.
items.explain: A 說參加了五次試鏡都沒被選上，覺得很灰心，這時候要鼓勵他：Don't give up.（別放棄）。「Good for you!」是聽到好消息時說的；其他選項說他已經成功或已經上電視，和 A 說的情況相反。

items.prompt:
A: Is it difficult to be a mail carrier?
B: ___
options: Yes, he is. He works every day.
No, I'm not. I'm a salesman.
Yes, I do. I like my job.
Yes, it is. I need to deliver mail on rainy days, too.
items.answer: Yes, it is. I need to deliver mail on rainy days, too.
items.explain: 問句是 Is it… to V?，主詞是虛主詞 it，簡答也要用 it：Yes, it is. / No, it isn't.。用 he is、I'm not、I do 回答，都是沒看清楚問句的主詞和 be 動詞。後半句說下雨天也要送信，正好說明為什麼辛苦。

items.prompt:
A: What does a secretary do?
B: ___
options: A secretary grows fruit and vegetables on a farm.
A secretary answers the phone and plans things for the boss.
My secretary is doing well, thank you.
Yes, a secretary does a lot.
items.answer: A secretary answers the phone and plans things for the boss.
items.explain: 這題問的是祕書「這個職業」做什麼工作，要回答工作內容：接電話、幫老闆安排事情。種水果蔬菜是農夫（farmer）的工作；What 開頭的問句不能用 Yes 回答；「is doing well」是回答近況好不好。

items.prompt:
A: What does Jack plan to do after finishing junior high school?
B: ___
options: He planned a trip last summer.
He plans to study cooking and become a cook.
Yes, he plans to do it.
items.answer: He plans to study cooking and become a cook.
items.explain: 問句是 What does Jack plan to do…?，問的是「計畫做什麼」，要用 He plans to + 原形動詞回答，而且時間是國中畢業以後。「planned a trip last summer」是過去的事；What 問句不能用 Yes 回答。

items.prompt:
A: Your sister sings so well. Does she want to be a singer?
B: ___
options: Yes, she did. She sang last night.
No, she wasn't. She was dancing.
Yes, she is. She is singing now.
Yes, she does. She dreams of singing on TV one day.
items.answer: Yes, she does. She dreams of singing on TV one day.
items.explain: 問句用 Does she…? 開頭，簡答要用 does / doesn't，不能用 did、wasn't 或 is。後面的 dream of + V-ing 表示「夢想做某事」，正好回答她想不想當歌手。這題要先看問句的助動詞是哪一個。

items.prompt:
A: How did you become so good at basketball?
B: ___
options: By practicing every day after school.
items.answer: By practicing every day after school.
items.explain: How 問的是「方法」，用 By + V-ing（藉由做某事）回答。Because… 是回答 Why；In the seventh grade 是回答 When；最後一個選項只是把問句的內容再說一次，沒有回答問題。

items.prompt:
A: I'm sorry for making fun of your dream.
B: ___
options: That's OK. Just don't do it again.
items.answer: That's OK. Just don't do it again.
items.explain: be sorry for + V-ing 是「為了做某事而道歉」，對方在道歉，要回答 That's OK.（沒關係）。「You're welcome.」是回答 Thank you 的；「Good for you!」是稱讚對方；make fun of 是「取笑」，不是「玩得開心」，不要被 fun 這個字誤導。

items.prompt:
A: Who do you want to interview for the school newspaper?
B: ___
options: I want to be a reporter.
Mr. Lee, the new PE teacher.
items.answer: Mr. Lee, the new PE teacher.
items.explain: Who 問的是「人」，問你想採訪誰，所以要回答一個人。「I want to be a reporter.」是回答 What do you want to be?；Because… 是回答 Why；At three… 是回答 When。這類題目先圈出疑問詞就不會錯。

items.prompt:
A: My parents want me to be a doctor, but I hope to be a farmer.
B: ___
options: Why do you want to be a doctor?
Good for them! They're good doctors.
Good. You and your parents have the same idea.
Did you talk to them about your dream?
items.answer: Did you talk to them about your dream?
items.explain: A 的意思是：爸媽要我當醫生，「但是」我自己希望當農夫，兩邊想法不同。最合理的回應是問他有沒有跟爸媽談過自己的夢想。想當醫生的是爸媽的期望而不是 A 本人，爸媽也不是醫生，想法更不一樣，所以其他三個選項都看錯了句意。

items.prompt:
A: ___
B: It's fun, but it's not easy to make a new video every week.
options: What do you want to be in the future?
How do you like being a YouTuber?
When did you start your channel?
items.answer: How do you like being a YouTuber?
items.explain: B 回答「很有趣，但每週做一支新影片不容易」，是在說做這份工作的感想，所以問句是 How do you like…?（你覺得…怎麼樣？）。問未來想當什麼要回答職業；Do you…? 要用 Yes / No 回答；When 要回答時間。
hope 後面接 to V，表示「希望去做某事」，所以是 hope to be。hope 不能直接接 V-ing 或原形動詞；to being 是把兩種寫法混在一起，也不對。
空格前面有 was，後面有 when I got there（我到的時候），表示那個時候她「正在」照顧狗，要用過去進行式 was + V-ing。這是 Unit 3 的 when 子句句型；was 後面不能再接過去式 took 或現在式 takes。
主詞是 Helping sick animals「幫助生病的動物這件事」，動名詞當主詞視為單數，動詞用 is。不要看到空格前面是複數的 animals 就選 are。
enjoy 後面只能接 V-ing，所以是 enjoy doing this job。enjoy to do 是最常見的錯誤；enjoy 不像 like 那樣兩種都可以。
前半句說「我不擅長自然科」，後半句說「我不想放棄」，前後意思相反，要用 but（但是）。so 是「所以」、because 是「因為」，放進去句意都不通。
need 後面接 to V，表示「需要去做某事」，所以是 need to sing。主詞是人的時候，need 後面不接 V-ing，也不能直接接原形動詞。
「我會緊張」和「人們看著我」是同時發生的兩件事，要用 when（當…的時候）連接。but、so、or 放進去句意都不通。
be good at 的 at 是介系詞，後面的動詞要用 V-ing，所以是 good at singing。看到 be good at、be bad at 就要想到後面接名詞或動名詞，不能接 to V 或原形。
空格後面是 practicing（V-ing），四個動詞裡只有 keep 後面接 V-ing，keep practicing 是「持續練習」。hope、decide、want 後面都要接 to V，所以不能選。這題要從空格「後面」的形式來判斷。
句型是 It is + 形容詞 + to V，It 是虛主詞，真正的主詞是後面的 to sing the song…。形容詞 helpful 後面不能直接接原形動詞或有時態變化的動詞。
前半句說他在工廠「賺得不錯」，後半句說他「不快樂」，前後意思相反，要用 but。選 so（所以）的話，變成「賺得多所以不快樂」，不合理。
dream of 的 of 是介系詞，後面要接 V-ing，所以是 dreamed of growing。雖然 dreamed 是過去式，但介系詞後面的動詞一律用 V-ing，不會跟著變成過去式 grew。
decide 後面接 to V，所以是 decided to give up his job。後面的 become 和 give 一樣是接在 to 後面的原形動詞（to give up… and become…）。decide 後面不接 V-ing。
空格到 farmer 是整句的主詞，後面的動詞是 is。動詞要當主詞必須改成動名詞（V-ing），所以用 Being a farmer。原形動詞 Be 不能直接當主詞；Is、Was 會讓句子變成有兩個動詞。
keep 後面接 V-ing，表示「持續做某事」，所以是 keeps working（一直工作到太陽下山）。keep 不接 to V，後面也不能再放一個有時態的動詞。
put on 是「穿上」（衣服、外套、鞋子）。句意是她每天早上穿上綠色外套再騎車出門。這個片語要整組背起來，其他介系詞都不能和 put 組成「穿上」的意思。
主詞是 Delivering letters on rainy days「在雨天送信這件事」，動名詞當主詞視為單數，動詞用 is。不要被 letters、days 這些複數名詞騙去選 are。
think about 的 about 是介系詞，後面要接 V-ing，所以是 thinks about leaving her job（考慮離開她的工作）。介系詞後面不接原形、to V 或過去式。
句型是 it is + 形容詞 + for 人 + to V。for them 後面要接 to V，所以是 to have。最常見的錯是看到主詞好像是 them 就選 have 或 has，或是看到介系詞 for 就選 having；其實 for them 只是說明「對誰來說」。
plan 後面接 to V，所以是 plans to keep；keep 後面再接 V-ing（keep working）。這格考的是 plan 的規則，不要因為後面有 working 就跟著選 keeping。
make fun of 是固定片語「取笑」，動詞只能用 make，過去式是 made。have fun 是「玩得開心」，後面不接 of，不要搞混。
think about 的 about 是介系詞，後面要接 V-ing，所以是 thought about giving up（考慮要放棄）。雖然 thought 是過去式，介系詞後面還是用 V-ing，不能用 gave。
It takes time to V 是「做某事需要花時間」，It 是虛主詞，真正的主詞是後面的不定詞 to be successful。這裡不能用 being、原形 be 或 is。
keep 後面接 V-ing，kept practicing 是「持續練習」。kept 已經是過去式了，後面不能再接一個過去式 practiced，也不能接 to V。
前一段說 Kevin 每天持續練習，這一段說電視公司打電話給他、他得到角色，是努力之後「終於」有了好結果，所以用 Finally。However 是「然而」，要用在前後意思相反的地方；Besides 是「此外」；First 是「首先」。

items.prompt: Why did Mr. Chen start working after junior high school?
options: He wanted to open a factory.
items.explain: 細節題。答案在第二段：Mr. Chen grew up in a poor family. After junior high school, he needed to make money, so he started working…。so 前面就是原因。文章沒有說他討厭讀書；親戚是後來取笑他，不是要他去工作。

items.prompt: What does "them" mean in the third paragraph?
items.explain: 指涉題。代名詞要往前找最近的複數名詞：He kept making different kinds of bread and asked people to try them for free.，被「試吃」的是前面的 different kinds of bread。young people 到第四段才出現，relatives 在第二段，都不是這裡指的東西。

items.prompt: What can we infer about Mr. Chen's relatives?
options: They didn't believe in his dream.
They gave him money for the shop.
They worked in the bread factory, too.
They wanted to learn to bake.
items.answer: They didn't believe in his dream.
items.explain: 推論題。第二段說親戚取笑他（made fun of him），還說開店要花很多錢、叫他好好待在工廠就好，可以推出他們不相信他的夢想會成功（believe in 是「對…有信心」）。文章沒有提到親戚給他錢、在工廠工作或想學烘焙。

items.prompt: What is the reading mainly about?
options: How to make different kinds of bread.
Why working in a factory is a good job.
A man kept trying and made his dream come true.
A reporter's interview with a baker.
items.answer: A man kept trying and made his dream come true.
items.explain: 主旨題。全文從他家境不好、被親戚取笑，寫到存錢十年開店、不斷嘗試新點子，最後成功，最後一句 It is important to follow your dream and never give up. 點出重點。文章沒有教怎麼做麵包，也不是記者的採訪。

items.prompt: How does Ms. Wu stay awake when she drives at night?
items.explain: 細節題。答案在 Ms. Wu 的第二段話：I keep singing to stay awake!。By + V-ing 表示「用…的方法」。喝咖啡、打電話給小孩、聽廣播在文章裡都沒有出現。

items.prompt: What does "that" mean in "But I didn't care about that"?
options: Some people's words about her job.
items.answer: Some people's words about her job.
items.explain: 指涉題。that 指的是前面剛說過的事：Some people made fun of me. They said, "Driving a truck is a man's job."，也就是別人取笑她的那些話。晚上開車和想念小孩是上一個問題的內容，離得太遠。

items.prompt: What can we infer from the interview?
options: Ms. Wu's father didn't want her to drive.
Ms. Wu has her own truck company now.
Lisa wants to be a truck driver, too.
Ms. Wu doesn't see her children every day.
items.answer: Ms. Wu doesn't see her children every day.
items.explain: 推論題。Ms. Wu 說 I'm away from home four days a week. I miss my kids a lot.，一週有四天不在家，所以不是每天都能見到小孩。爸爸教她開車，不是反對她開車；有自己的公司是她「希望」的事（I hope to…），現在還沒有。

items.prompt: What is the interview mainly about?
options: How to drive a truck at night.
A woman truck driver's job and her dream.
Why Lisa wants to be a reporter.
A truck company and its new drivers.
items.answer: A woman truck driver's job and her dream.
items.explain: 主旨題。Lisa 的四個問題分別問了為什麼當卡車司機、工作難不難、別人怎麼說、未來的計畫，都圍繞著 Ms. Wu 的工作和夢想。文章沒有教怎麼開卡車，也沒有談 Lisa 自己的志願。

items.prompt: Kevin wants to join the club. What does he need to do first?
options: Write a story for the school newspaper.
Make a video for the YouTube channel.
Interview a soldier, a dentist, and a fisherman.
Give the form to Ms. Lin before September 20.
items.answer: Give the form to Ms. Lin before September 20.
items.explain: 細節題。答案在 How to join? 的第一點：Fill out the form and give it to Ms. Lin… before September 20.，面試是之後 9 月 23 日的事。寫報導、拍影片、採訪都是「加入之後」社團做的活動（What do we do?），不是報名的步驟。

items.prompt: Who can NOT join the club?
options: Tom. He is in the seventh grade and isn't good at writing.
Amy. She is in the ninth grade and writes very well.
Lisa. She is in the eighth grade and loves talking to people.
Ben. He is in the eighth grade and is free on Wednesday afternoons.
items.answer: Amy. She is in the ninth grade and writes very well.
items.explain: 推論題。Who can join? 寫著只有 Students in the seventh and eighth grades 可以參加，Amy 是九年級，寫得再好也不能加入。Tom 雖然不擅長寫作，但文中說 You don't need to be good at writing now，所以他可以參加。

items.prompt: What does "it" mean in "Don't worry about it"?
items.explain: 指涉題。it 指前一句提到的單數名詞：There is a short interview on September 23. Don't worry about it!，叫大家不用擔心的是那場面試。表格在上一點，而且交表格沒有什麼好擔心的。

items.prompt: What is this reading for?
options: To teach students to write news stories.
To tell students about a new teacher.
To ask students to join a club.
items.answer: To ask students to join a club.
items.explain: 主旨題（寫作目的）。標題是 Join the Student Reporter Club!，開頭說 Come and join us!，最後說名額只有十五個、不要再等了，整篇都是在招募新社員。文章沒有教怎麼寫新聞，也不是在介紹老師或賣報紙。

items.prompt: What did Judy tell the writer to do before going on stage?
options: Look at everyone in the classroom.
Tell the teacher about being sick.
items.explain: 細節題。答案在第三段 Judy 說的話：Close your eyes and take three deep breaths before going on stage.。Judy 說的是 Don't look at everyone，所以「看著每個人」剛好相反；跟老師說生病是作者自己原本想做的事，不是 Judy 說的。

items.prompt: What does "It worked!" mean in the diary?
options: The writer got a new job.
items.explain: 字義題。work 在這裡不是「工作」，而是「有效」。It 指前一段最後 I decided to try it 的 it，也就是 Judy 教的方法；後面接著寫作者只看著 Judy、順利拉完曲子，可見方法有用。把 work 直接想成「工作」就會選錯。

items.prompt: What can we infer about the writer?
options: The writer isn't so afraid of playing in front of people now.
The writer played the violin badly at the show.
The writer and Judy played music together.
The writer didn't practice before the show.
items.answer: The writer isn't so afraid of playing in front of people now.
items.explain: 推論題。最後一句 I plan to join the school music contest next month! 表示作者願意再上臺表演，可見不再那麼害怕了。大家鼓掌、老師說 That was beautiful!，所以不是拉得不好；文中說 I practiced for a month，所以有練習；Judy 只是在臺下微笑，沒有一起表演。

items.prompt: What is the diary mainly about?
options: How to play the violin well.
Why Ms. Wang was angry at the writer.
The school music contest next month.
A friend helped the writer do well at a show.
items.answer: A friend helped the writer do well at a show.
items.explain: 主旨題。整篇日記寫的是作者上臺前很緊張，好朋友 Judy 教了一個方法，最後順利完成表演。音樂比賽只在最後一句提到，是之後的計畫，不是重點；文章也沒有教拉小提琴的技巧。

items.prompt: Which is true about the speakers on Career Day?
options: The soldier taught the students to exercise.
The salesman was the first speaker.
The secretary answers many phone calls every day.
The farmer sells strawberries at Emma's school.
items.answer: The secretary answers many phone calls every day.
items.explain: 細節題。第二段說祕書 answers about fifty phone calls a day，所以這個選項正確。第一位講者是士兵（The first speaker was a soldier），他只是說自己運動量很大，沒有教學生運動；農夫是請大家「試吃」草莓（let us try），不是在學校賣。

items.prompt: What does "That" mean in "That surprised me"?
items.explain: 指涉題。That 指前一句銷售員說的話："Listening to people is the first step."。下一句 I thought salesmen just needed to talk a lot. 說明了為什麼驚訝：Emma 原本以為銷售員只要很會說話就好。草莓到第三段才出現。

items.prompt: What can we infer from the email?
options: Emma wants to be a soldier in the future.
Emma's grandma was at Career Day, too.
Emma visits her grandma every Friday.
Emma's grandma knows a lot about growing vegetables.
items.answer: Emma's grandma knows a lot about growing vegetables.
items.explain: 推論題。Emma 在最後問 Can you teach me to do that…? You are so good at growing things!，可見奶奶很會種東西。Emma 說自己 bad at getting up early，沒有說想當士兵；她寫信告訴奶奶這件事，表示奶奶當天不在場；她是 next month 才要去看奶奶。

items.prompt: Why did Emma write this email?
options: To tell her grandma about Career Day and ask for her help.
To ask her grandma to speak at her school.
To thank her grandma for the strawberries.
To tell her grandma about her new job.
items.answer: To tell her grandma about Career Day and ask for her help.
items.explain: 主旨題（寫作目的）。信的開頭說 I want to tell you about Career Day，最後請奶奶教她種菜（Can you teach me to do that…?），所以有兩個目的：分享職業日，並請奶奶幫忙。草莓是農夫給的，不是奶奶給的；Emma 是學生，沒有新工作。

items.prompt: My cousin hopes {{1}} (be) a dentist in the future.
items.explain: hope（希望）後面的第二個動作要用不定詞 to V，所以是 hopes to be。be 動詞的不定詞是 to be，不是 to is 或 to being。常見錯誤是寫成 being，但 hope 不能接 V-ing。

items.prompt: Mom needs me {{1}} (hang) the clothes before it rains.
items.explain: 這是「need + 人 + to V」的句型：媽媽需要「我」去做某件事。線索是 needs 後面先有受詞 me，後面的動作要用 to hang。常見錯誤是直接寫 hang 或 hanging，漏掉 to。

items.prompt: Ms. Lin asked us {{1}} (not make) fun of the new student.
items.explain: 「ask + 人 + to V」是要求某人做某事；要求某人「不要」做，要把 not 放在 to 的前面，寫成 not to make。常見錯誤是寫成 don't make 或 to not make；一個句子已經有主要動詞 asked，後面不能再用 don't。

items.prompt: Lisa doesn't {{1}} (want) {{2}} (move) to another city.
items.explain: 否定句的助動詞 doesn't 後面一定接原形動詞，所以第一格是 want，不可以寫 wants。want 後面的動作用不定詞，所以第二格是 to move。最常見的錯誤是寫成 doesn't wants。

items.prompt: My uncle taught my brother {{1}} (drive) a truck last summer.
items.explain: 「teach + 人 + to V」表示教某人做某事，所以用 to drive。雖然句子是過去式（taught、last summer），但 to 後面永遠接原形動詞，不可以寫成 to drove。

items.prompt: Last night, we {{1}} (decide) {{2}} (take) a trip to Tainan.
items.explain: Last night 是過去的時間，主要動詞 decide 要改成過去式 decided。decide（決定）後面的動作用不定詞 to take。記得：時態只變在主要動詞上，to 後面永遠是原形，不要寫成 to took。

items.prompt: Jason enjoys {{1}} (make) videos for his channel.
items.explain: enjoy（喜愛、享受）後面只能接動名詞 V-ing，不能接 to V。make 字尾是不發音的 e，要先去掉 e 再加 ing，寫成 making。常見錯誤是寫成 to make 或拼成 makeing。

items.prompt: My sister practices {{1}} (swim) at the pool twice a week.
items.explain: practice（練習）後面只能接 V-ing。swim 是「短母音 + 一個子音」結尾，要重複字尾 m 再加 ing，寫成 swimming。常見錯誤是寫成 to swim 或少寫一個 m。

items.prompt: Dad finished {{1}} (fix) the drawer and started {{2}} (mop) the floor.
items.explain: finish（完成）後面只能接 V-ing，所以第一格是 fixing（x 結尾不重複字尾）。start 後面接 to V 或 V-ing 都可以，所以第二格寫 to mop 或 mopping 都對；mop 要重複 p 再加 ing。

items.prompt: The little girl loves {{1}} (dance) in front of people.
items.explain: like、love、hate、start 這四個動詞後面接 to V 或 V-ing 都可以，意思一樣，所以 to dance 和 dancing 都正確。dance 字尾是 e，改成 V-ing 時要去 e 加 ing。只寫原形 dance 就錯了，因為一個句子不能有兩個主要動詞。

items.prompt: My brother kept {{1}} (sit) in front of the TV all afternoon.
items.explain: keep（持續）後面只能接 V-ing，表示一直做某件事，kept 是 keep 的過去式，規則不變。sit 要重複字尾 t 再加 ing，寫成 sitting。常見錯誤是寫成 kept to sit 或 kept sat。

items.prompt: Peter hates {{1}} (get) up early on cold mornings.
items.explain: hate（討厭）和 like、love、start 一樣，後面接 to V 或 V-ing 都可以，所以 to get 和 getting 都對。get 改成 V-ing 要重複字尾 t，寫成 getting。不可以寫 gets，因為主要動詞已經是 hates。

items.prompt: Amy is good at {{1}} (run), but she is bad at {{2}} (dance).
items.explain: at 是介系詞，介系詞後面的動作一定要用 V-ing，所以 be good at 和 be bad at 後面都接動名詞。run 要重複字尾 n 變成 running；dance 去 e 加 ing 變成 dancing。常見錯誤是寫成 good at run 或 good at to run。

items.prompt: After {{1}} (study) for two hours, Tom took a break.
items.explain: after 在這裡是介系詞，後面沒有主詞，所以動詞要用 V-ing。study 改成 V-ing 時直接加 ing，y 不用變，寫成 studying。常見錯誤是寫成 studing（少了 y）或用過去式 studied。

items.prompt: Linda dreams of {{1}} (be) a reporter one day.
items.explain: dream of（夢想）的 of 是介系詞，後面要接 V-ing。be 動詞的 V-ing 形式是 being，所以寫 dreams of being。常見錯誤是寫成 of to be 或 of be；介系詞後面不能接 to V 或原形。

items.prompt: I'm sorry for {{1}} (break) your window.
items.explain: be sorry for（為…感到抱歉）的 for 是介系詞，後面的動作要用 V-ing，所以是 breaking。雖然打破窗戶是過去的事，介系詞後面還是用 V-ing，不可以寫成 for broke。

items.prompt: You can learn English well by {{1}} (practice) it every day.
items.explain: by + V-ing 表示「藉由（做某事）」，by 是介系詞，所以後面用動名詞。practice 字尾是 e，去 e 加 ing 變成 practicing。常見錯誤是寫成 by practice 或 by to practice。

items.prompt: My parents are talking about {{1}} (move) to the country.
items.explain: talk about（談論）的 about 是介系詞，後面的動作要用 V-ing。move 去 e 加 ing 變成 moving。注意這句的 are talking 是現在進行式，而 moving 是介系詞後面的動名詞，兩個 V-ing 的作用不一樣。

items.prompt: {{1}} (get) up early {{2}} (be) not easy for me.
items.explain: 句子開頭的動作當主詞時，要改成動名詞 Getting（重複 t）或不定詞 To get，不能直接用原形 Get。動名詞或不定詞當主詞算「一件事」，所以 be 動詞用單數 is。寫成原形 Get up early 會變成命令句。

items.prompt: {{1}} (deliver) letters and packages {{2}} (be) a mail carrier's job.
items.explain: 主詞是「送信和包裹」這一件事，所以用動名詞 Delivering（或不定詞 To deliver）開頭，be 動詞用單數 is。陷阱是空格前面的 letters and packages 是複數，但它們只是 deliver 的受詞，真正的主詞是「送」這個動作，不可以用 are。

items.prompt: Riding a bike and playing basketball {{1}} (be) my favorite sports.
items.explain: 這句有兩個動名詞 Riding a bike 和 playing basketball 用 and 連接，是「兩件事」，所以 be 動詞用複數 are。線索是 and 連接了兩個 V-ing，而且後面的 sports 也是複數。只有一個動名詞當主詞時才用 is。

items.prompt: {{1}} (be) a fisherman {{2}} (be) hard work.
items.explain: 「當漁夫」這件事當主詞，be 動詞要改成動名詞 Being 或不定詞 To be，不能用原形 Be。動名詞當主詞視為單數，所以第二格用 is。常見錯誤是第一格寫 Be 或 Is。

items.prompt: {{1}} (lie) to your parents is wrong.
items.explain: 「對父母說謊」這件事當主詞，要用動名詞或不定詞。lie 的 V-ing 很特別：字尾 ie 要改成 y 再加 ing，寫成 lying，不是 lieing。用不定詞 To lie 開頭也可以。

items.prompt: Finding a good job {{1}} (be) not easy for my uncle last year.
items.explain: 動名詞片語 Finding a good job 當主詞，視為單數；句尾的 last year 表示過去，所以 be 動詞用過去式單數 was。常見錯誤是沒注意到 last year 而寫成 is，或是寫成 were。

items.prompt: It is important {{1}} (brush) your teeth after meals.
items.explain: 這是虛主詞句型「It is + 形容詞 + to V」：It 只是先佔住主詞的位置，真正的主詞是後面的 to brush your teeth after meals。形容詞 important 後面的動作要用 to V。常見錯誤是寫成 brushing 或原形 brush。

items.prompt: It was not easy for Amy {{1}} (find) a job in the city.
items.explain: 句型是「It + be + 形容詞 + for 人 + to V」，for Amy 表示「對 Amy 來說」，後面的動作用 to find。雖然 be 動詞是過去式 was，但 to 後面永遠接原形動詞，不可以寫成 to found。

items.prompt: It is a good idea {{1}} (not eat) too much before bed.
items.explain: 虛主詞 It 的句型也可以用名詞：It is a good idea + to V。要表達「不要做」時，not 放在 to 的前面，寫成 not to eat。常見錯誤是寫成 don't eat 或 to not eat。

items.prompt: It {{1}} (be) fun {{2}} (fly) kites at the park last Sunday.
items.explain: 句尾的 last Sunday 是過去的時間，所以 be 動詞用過去式；主詞是 It，要用單數 was。fun 後面的真主詞用不定詞 to fly。空格後面的 kites 雖然是複數，但主詞是 It，不可以寫 were。

items.prompt: It is my dream {{1}} (be) a successful lawyer.
items.explain: It 是虛主詞，真正的主詞是後面的不定詞片語，所以用 to be。be 動詞的不定詞是 to be。如果改用動名詞當主詞，句子會變成 Being a successful lawyer is my dream.，兩種寫法不要混在一起。

items.prompt: Is it difficult for you {{1}} (speak) English in front of the class?
items.explain: 這是虛主詞句型的疑問句：把 be 動詞 Is 移到 it 前面，其他不變，仍然是「形容詞 + for 人 + to V」。for you 後面的動作用 to speak。常見錯誤是看到 for 就寫 speaking，但這裡的動作是真主詞，要用 to V。

answers: My parents want me to become a doctor.
items.explain: 句型是「want + 人 + to V」：先寫想要的人 My parents want，再放受詞 me，最後才是 to become a doctor。常見錯誤是把 me 放到 to become 後面；記住「人」要緊跟在 want 後面。

answers: Kevin didn't plan to join the art club.
items.explain: 否定句的順序是「主詞 + didn't + 原形動詞」，所以是 Kevin didn't plan。plan 後面的動作用不定詞 to join。注意 didn't 後面是原形 plan，不是 planned。

answers: What does your sister hope to be in the future?
items.explain: wh- 問句的順序是「疑問詞 + 助動詞 does + 主詞 + 原形動詞」，所以是 What does your sister hope。hope 後面接不定詞 to be，時間 in the future 放句尾。助動詞 does 後面的 hope 不加 s。

answers: My brother enjoys playing online games after school.
items.explain: enjoy 後面接 V-ing，所以 enjoys 後面緊接 playing online games。時間 after school 放在句尾。常見錯誤是想找 to 來接在 enjoy 後面，但 enjoy 只能接動名詞。

answers: Did you finish cleaning your room?
items.explain: 過去式問句的順序是「Did + 主詞 + 原形動詞」，所以是 Did you finish。finish 後面接 V-ing，所以再接 cleaning your room。Did 後面的 finish 要用原形，不加 ed。

answers: We need to practice speaking English every day.
items.explain: 這句有兩層：need 後面接 to V，所以是 need to practice；practice 後面接 V-ing，所以是 practice speaking English。順序要看「前一個動詞」決定後面用 to V 還是 V-ing。時間 every day 放句尾。

answers: Are you good at drawing pictures?
items.explain: be good at 的問句要把 be 動詞移到主詞前面：Are you good at…。at 是介系詞，後面接 V-ing，所以是 good at drawing pictures。

answers: Tom is thinking about joining the baseball team.
items.explain: think about（考慮）的 about 是介系詞，後面接動名詞 joining。順序是 Tom is thinking about + joining the baseball team。這句的 is thinking 是現在進行式，joining 則是介系詞後面的動名詞。

answers: My sister worries about not having enough money.
items.explain: worry about（擔心）後面接 V-ing；要表達「沒有」時，把 not 放在 V-ing 的前面，寫成 not having。所以順序是 worries about not having enough money。常見錯誤是寫成 about don't have。

answers: Being a good student is not easy.
items.explain: 大寫開頭的 Being 是句首，Being a good student（當一個好學生）整個是主詞，後面接單數動詞 is，再接 not easy。be 動詞當主詞時要用動名詞 Being。

answers: Watching too much TV is bad for your eyes.
items.explain: 動名詞片語 Watching too much TV（看太多電視）當主詞，後面接單數動詞 is。be bad for 表示「對…不好」，所以最後是 bad for your eyes。先找出大寫的 V-ing 當句首，再找動詞 is。

answers: Reading books and listening to music are my hobbies.
items.explain: 兩個動名詞片語用 and 連接當主詞：Reading books and listening to music，是兩件事，所以動詞用複數 are，後面接 my hobbies。大寫的 Reading books 要放句首。

answers: It is important for students to get enough sleep.
items.explain: 虛主詞句型的順序是「It is + 形容詞 + for 人 + to V」：It is important for students to get enough sleep。常見錯誤是把 for students 放在 to get 後面；記住「for 人」要放在形容詞和 to V 的中間。

answers: Is it easy for you to make new friends?
items.explain: 虛主詞句型的問句要把 be 動詞放到 it 前面：Is it + 形容詞 + for 人 + to V。所以順序是 Is it easy for you to make new friends?。

answers: It was not a good idea to go out in the rain.
items.explain: 虛主詞 It 後面除了形容詞，也可以接名詞：It was not a good idea + to V。not 放在 be 動詞 was 的後面，真正的主詞 to go out in the rain 放最後。

items.zh: 我弟弟希望有一天成為一名軍人。
items.prompt: My brother {{1}} {{2}} {{3}} a soldier one day.
items.explain: 「希望」是 hope，主詞 My brother 是第三人稱單數，要加 s 寫成 hopes。hope 後面的動作用不定詞 to V，所以是 to be 或 to become。常見錯誤是漏掉 hopes 的 s，或寫成 hopes being。

items.zh: 媽媽昨天要求我餵狗。
items.prompt: Mom {{1}} me {{2}} {{3}} the dog yesterday.
items.explain: 「要求某人做某事」是 ask + 人 + to V。句尾有 yesterday，所以 ask 要用過去式 asked。to 後面接原形動詞 feed，不可以寫成 fed 或 feeding。

items.zh: Lisa 今天不需要洗碗。
items.prompt: Lisa {{1}} need {{2}} {{3}} the dishes today.
items.explain: 主詞 Lisa 是第三人稱單數，否定句用 doesn't，後面的 need 用原形。need 後面的動作用不定詞 to do（或 to wash）。「洗碗」是 do the dishes 或 wash the dishes。常見錯誤是用 don't，或寫成 isn't need。

items.zh: 他們決定不放棄。
items.prompt: They decided {{1}} {{2}} give {{3}}.
items.explain: decide 後面接 to V；要表達「決定不做」時，把 not 放在 to 的前面，寫成 decided not to give up。「放棄」是片語 give up。常見錯誤是寫成 decided to not 或 decided don't。

items.zh: 我爸爸很享受在農場上種蔬菜。
items.prompt: My dad {{1}} {{2}} vegetables on the farm.
items.explain: 「享受、喜愛」是 enjoy，主詞 My dad 是第三人稱單數，所以是 enjoys。enjoy 後面只能接 V-ing，「種植」grow 要寫成 growing。常見錯誤是寫成 enjoys to grow。

items.zh: Amy 昨天下午掃完地板了。
items.prompt: Amy {{1}} {{2}} the floor yesterday afternoon.
items.explain: 「做完某事」是 finish + V-ing。句子有 yesterday afternoon，finish 要用過去式 finished；後面的「掃」sweep 要用動名詞 sweeping。常見錯誤是寫成 finished to sweep 或 finished swept。

items.zh: 只要持續練習，你就會成功。
items.prompt: Just {{1}} {{2}}, and you will be {{3}}.
items.explain: 「持續做某事」是 keep + V-ing，Just 開頭是祈使句，所以 keep 用原形，後面接 practicing（practice 去 e 加 ing）。will be 後面要用形容詞 successful（成功的），不是名詞 success。

items.zh: 我妹妹討厭洗碗，但是她喜愛煮飯。
items.prompt: My sister {{1}} {{2}} the dishes, but she {{3}} {{4}}.
items.explain: 「討厭」是 hate、「喜愛」是 love，主詞是第三人稱單數，都要加 s。hate 和 love 後面接 to V 或 V-ing 都可以，但這裡一格只能填一個字，所以要用 V-ing：doing（或 washing）和 cooking。

items.zh: 我哥哥很擅長修理東西。
items.prompt: My brother is {{1}} {{2}} {{3}} things.
items.explain: 「擅長」是 be good at，at 是介系詞，後面的動作要用 V-ing，所以「修理」fix 寫成 fixing。常見錯誤是介系詞寫成 in，或是寫成 good at fix。

items.zh: 我很抱歉我遲到了。
items.prompt: I'm sorry {{1}} {{2}} late.
items.explain: 「為…感到抱歉」是 be sorry for，for 是介系詞，後面要接 V-ing。「遲到」是 be late，be 動詞的 V-ing 是 being，所以寫 sorry for being late。常見錯誤是寫成 for be late 或 for am late。

items.zh: Amy 正在考慮加入舞蹈社。
items.prompt: Amy is {{1}} {{2}} {{3}} the dance club.
items.explain: 「考慮」是 think about（或 think of）。「正在」要用現在進行式 is thinking；about 是介系詞，後面的「加入」join 要用 V-ing，寫成 joining。常見錯誤是寫成 thinking about to join。

items.zh: 他靠送報紙賺錢。
items.prompt: He makes money {{1}} {{2}} newspapers.
items.explain: 「藉由、靠（做某事）」用 by + V-ing。「遞送」是本單元單字 deliver，放在介系詞 by 後面要寫成 delivering。常見錯誤是介系詞用 with，或寫成 by deliver。

items.zh: 當秘書不是一份容易的工作。
items.prompt: {{1}} a secretary {{2}} not an easy job.
items.explain: 「當秘書」這件事當主詞，be 動詞要改成動名詞 Being 放句首。動名詞當主詞視為單數，所以動詞用 is。常見錯誤是句首直接寫 Be 或 Is。

items.zh: 取笑別人是不對的。
items.prompt: {{1}} fun {{2}} others {{3}} wrong.
items.explain: 「取笑」是片語 make fun of。這個動作當主詞，make 要改成動名詞 Making（去 e 加 ing）。動名詞當主詞用單數動詞 is；雖然前面的 others 是複數，但主詞是「取笑」這件事，不能用 are。

items.zh: 游泳和慢跑都是很好的運動。
items.prompt: {{1}} and {{2}} {{3}} good sports.
items.explain: 兩個動名詞用 and 連接當主詞，是兩件事，所以動詞用複數 are。swim 和 jog 都要重複字尾再加 ing：swimming、jogging。常見錯誤是動詞寫成 is，或少寫一個 m／g。

items.zh: 開卡車需要很多練習。
items.prompt: {{1}} a truck {{2}} a lot of practice.
items.explain: 「開卡車」這件事當主詞，drive 要去 e 加 ing 寫成 Driving。動名詞當主詞視為第三人稱單數，所以一般動詞要加 s：takes（或 needs）。常見錯誤是動詞忘了加 s。

items.zh: 對我來說，早起很困難。
items.prompt: {{1}} is difficult {{2}} me {{3}} get up early.
items.explain: 這是虛主詞句型「It is + 形容詞 + for 人 + to V」。句首用 It 代替真正的主詞，「對我來說」是 for me（for 後面用受格），真正的主詞是 to get up early。常見錯誤是把 for 寫成 to。

items.zh: 學習新事物很有趣。
items.prompt: It {{1}} interesting {{2}} {{3}} new things.
items.explain: 虛主詞句型「It is + 形容詞 + to V」：It 後面用單數 be 動詞 is，形容詞 interesting 後面接不定詞 to learn。to 後面一定是原形動詞，不可以寫成 to learning。

items.zh: 對小孩來說，獨自待在家是危險的。
items.prompt: It is dangerous {{1}} kids {{2}} {{3}} home alone.
items.explain: 句型是「It is + 形容詞 + for 人 + to V」。「對小孩來說」是 for kids，放在形容詞 dangerous 的後面，然後才接真主詞 to stay home alone。「待在家」是 stay home。

items.zh: 昨天能和你聊天真好。
items.prompt: It {{1}} nice {{2}} {{3}} with you yesterday.
items.explain: 句尾有 yesterday，所以 It 後面的 be 動詞用過去式 was。形容詞 nice 後面接不定詞 to talk。記得時態只變在 be 動詞上，to 後面還是原形動詞，不可以寫成 to talked。

items.prompt: Jenny <u>takes</u> piano lessons on weekends.
items.cue: 畫線部分前加入 want
answers: Jenny wants to take piano lessons on weekends.
items.explain: 加入 want 之後，want 變成句子的主要動詞，主詞 Jenny 是第三人稱單數，所以 s 要加在 want 上：wants。原本的動詞 takes 變成第二個動作，要改成不定詞 to take（to 後面用原形）。常見錯誤是寫成 want to takes 或 wants take。

items.prompt: Kevin wants to be a salesman.
items.cue: 改為否定句
answers: Kevin doesn't want to be a salesman.
items.explain: 一般動詞的否定句要用助動詞：主詞 Kevin 是第三人稱單數，用 doesn't，後面的 wants 要改回原形 want。後面的 to be a salesman 不用變。常見錯誤是寫成 doesn't wants 或 isn't want。

items.prompt: My father <u>takes</u> pictures of birds.
items.cue: 畫線部分前加入 enjoy
answers: My father enjoys taking pictures of birds.
items.explain: 加入 enjoy 後，它變成主要動詞，要配合主詞 My father 加 s：enjoys。enjoy 後面只能接 V-ing，所以 takes 要改成 taking（take 去 e 加 ing）。常見錯誤是寫成 enjoys to take 或 enjoy takes。

items.prompt: Amy practiced to play the violin for two hours.
items.cue: 這個句子有一個錯誤，寫出正確的句子
answers: Amy practiced playing the violin for two hours.
items.explain: practice（練習）後面只能接動名詞 V-ing，不能接 to V，所以 to play 要改成 playing。只接 V-ing 的動詞要背起來：enjoy、keep、practice、finish。

items.prompt: Tom brushed his teeth. Then he went to bed.
items.cue: 用 before + V-ing 合併成一句（以 Tom 開頭）
answers: Tom brushed his teeth before going to bed.
items.explain: 先刷牙、後上床，所以是「在上床之前刷牙」：brushed his teeth before going to bed。before 當介系詞時，後面的動作要用 V-ing，所以 went 要改成 going，而且不用再寫主詞 he。常見錯誤是寫成 before went to bed。

items.prompt: Linda can't cook well.
items.cue: 用 be bad at 改寫
answers: Linda('s| is) bad at cooking.
items.explain: 「不會煮飯」可以說成「不擅長煮飯」：be bad at + V-ing。主詞 Linda 配 be 動詞 is；at 是介系詞，後面的 cook 要改成 cooking。常見錯誤是寫成 is bad at cook，或把 can't 留在句子裡。

items.prompt: It is exciting to watch baseball games.
items.cue: 用動名詞當主詞改寫
answers: Watching baseball games is exciting.
items.explain: 把真正的主詞 to watch baseball games 搬到句首，並改成動名詞 Watching baseball games，原本的虛主詞 It 就不需要了。動名詞當主詞用單數動詞 is；雖然 games 是複數，也不可以用 are。

items.prompt: Collecting stamps are my hobby.
items.cue: 這個句子有一個錯誤，寫出正確的句子
answers: Collecting stamps is my hobby.
items.explain: 主詞是動名詞片語 Collecting stamps（集郵），指的是「收集」這一件事，所以動詞要用單數 is。stamps 雖然是複數，但它只是 collecting 的受詞，不是主詞。這是段考最常考的陷阱。

items.prompt: Learning to swim is not difficult.
items.cue: 用虛主詞 It 開頭改寫
answers: It is not difficult to learn to swim.
items.explain: 用虛主詞 It 開頭時，先寫 It is not difficult，再把真正的主詞放到後面，並把動名詞 Learning 改成不定詞 to learn。句型是「It is + 形容詞 + to V」。常見錯誤是後面仍然寫 learning。

items.prompt: It is easy for she to make friends.
items.cue: 這個句子有一個錯誤，寫出正確的句子
answers: It is easy for her to make friends.
items.explain: for 是介系詞，後面的人要用受格，所以 she 要改成 her。句型是「It is + 形容詞 + for 人（受格）+ to V」。同樣地，要寫 for me、for him、for us、for them。

items.zh: Amy 希望成為一位成功的律師。
items.cue: 用 hope
answers: Amy hopes to (be|become) a successful lawyer.
items.explain: hope 後面接不定詞 to V，「成為」可以用 be 或 become。主詞 Amy 是第三人稱單數，hope 要加 s。常見錯誤是漏掉 s，或寫成 hopes being。

items.zh: 我爸爸要我每天倒垃圾。
items.cue: 用 want
answers: (My dad|My father|Dad|Father) wants me to (take out the (trash|garbage)|take the (trash|garbage) out) every day.
items.explain: 「要某人做某事」是 want + 人 + to V：wants me to take out the trash。人要用受格 me，而且緊跟在 wants 後面。常見錯誤是寫成 wants I take 或漏掉 to。

items.zh: Tom 星期天不需要早起。
items.cue: 用 need
answers: Tom doesn't need to (get|wake) up early on (Sunday|Sundays).
items.explain: need 後面接不定詞 to V。否定句用 doesn't + 原形 need，再接 to get up early。星期前面的介系詞用 on。常見錯誤是寫成 doesn't needs 或 isn't need。

items.zh: Kevin 很享受和朋友打籃球。
items.cue: 用 enjoy
answers: Kevin [really ]enjoys playing basketball with [his ]friends[ (very much|a lot)].
items.explain: enjoy 後面只能接 V-ing，所以是 enjoys playing basketball。主詞 Kevin 是第三人稱單數，enjoy 要加 s。球類運動前面不加 the。常見錯誤是寫成 enjoys to play。

items.zh: 那個嬰兒整晚一直哭。
items.cue: 用 keep，過去式
answers: (The|That) baby kept crying (all night[ long]|the whole night).
items.explain: 「一直做某事」是 keep + V-ing，keep 的過去式是不規則變化 kept。cry 改成 V-ing 直接加 ing：crying。常見錯誤是寫成 keeped 或 kept to cry。

items.zh: Lisa 喜歡在週末烤蛋糕。
items.cue: 用 like
answers: Lisa likes (to bake|baking|to make|making) (cakes|a cake) (on weekends|on the weekend|on the weekends|at weekends|at the weekend).
items.explain: like 後面接 to V 或 V-ing 都可以，所以 likes to bake cakes 和 likes baking cakes 都對。主詞 Lisa 是第三人稱單數，like 要加 s。只寫 likes bake 是錯的，因為一個句子不能有兩個主要動詞。

items.zh: 我姊姊很擅長畫畫。
items.cue: 用 be good at
answers: My [(older|elder|big) ]sister is [(very|really) ]good at (drawing|painting)[ pictures].
items.explain: 「擅長」是 be good at，at 是介系詞，後面要接 V-ing，所以是 good at drawing。主詞 My sister 配 be 動詞 is。常見錯誤是寫成 good at draw 或 good in drawing。

items.zh: 謝謝你教我游泳。
items.cue: 用 Thank you for
answers: Thank you for teaching me [how ]to swim.
items.explain: Thank you for 的 for 是介系詞，後面的動作要用 V-ing，所以是 for teaching。「教某人做某事」是 teach + 人 + to V，所以後面接 me to swim。這句同時用到「介系詞 + V-ing」和「teach + 人 + to V」。

items.zh: Amy 夢想成為一位記者。
items.cue: 用 dream of
answers: Amy dreams of (being|becoming) a reporter.
items.explain: dream of 的 of 是介系詞，後面要接 V-ing，「成為」用 being 或 becoming。主詞 Amy 是第三人稱單數，dream 要加 s。常見錯誤是寫成 dreams of to be 或 dreams of be。

items.zh: 吃太多糖果對你的牙齒不好。
items.cue: 用動名詞開頭
answers: Eating too (much candy|many candies|many sweets) is (bad|not good) for your teeth.
items.explain: 「吃太多糖果」這件事當主詞，用動名詞 Eating 開頭。動名詞當主詞視為單數，動詞用 is。「對…不好」是 be bad for。牙齒的複數是 teeth，不是 tooths。

items.zh: 學英文對我來說很有趣。
items.cue: 用動名詞開頭
answers: (Learning|Studying) English is ([(very|really|so) ](fun|interesting)|a lot of fun|great fun) (for|to) me.
items.explain: 「學英文」這件事當主詞，用動名詞 Learning English 開頭，動詞用單數 is。「對我來說」是 for me。常見錯誤是句首寫原形 Learn English is…，原形動詞不能當主詞。

items.zh: 成為一位牙醫是 Kevin 的夢想。
items.cue: 用不定詞 To 開頭
answers: To (be|become) a dentist is Kevin's dream.
items.explain: 不定詞 to V 也可以當主詞，放句首時 To 要大寫：To be a dentist。不定詞當主詞和動名詞一樣視為單數，動詞用 is。「Kevin 的」要寫成 Kevin's。

items.zh: 對我來說，在大家面前說英文很難。
items.cue: 用 It 開頭
answers: It is [(very|really|so) ](hard|difficult) for me to speak English in front of (everyone|everybody|people|others|other people).
items.explain: 句型是「It is + 形容詞 + for 人 + to V」：It is hard for me to speak English。「在…面前」是 in front of。常見錯誤是把 for me 放到句尾，或是寫成 It is hard for me speaking。

items.zh: 和朋友去露營很有趣。
items.cue: 用 It 開頭
answers: It is ([(very|really|so) ](fun|interesting)|great fun|a lot of fun) to go camping with [(my|your|our) ]friends.
items.explain: 虛主詞句型「It is + 形容詞 + to V」：It is fun to go camping。「去露營」是 go camping。真正的主詞是後面的 to go camping with friends，所以 fun 後面要用 to V，不是原形。

items.zh: 對我們來說，要找到那間工廠並不容易。（過去的事）
items.cue: 用 It 開頭，過去式
answers: It was not easy for us to find (the|that) factory.
items.explain: 過去的事，be 動詞用 was；否定 not 放在 was 後面。「對我們來說」是 for us（受格），後面接 to find。to 後面永遠是原形動詞，不可以寫成 to found。

items.prompt: Nina wants ___ a nurse in the future.
items.explain: want（想要）後面要接另一個動作時，一定用 to + 原形動詞，所以是 wants to be。線索就是空格前面的 wants。最常見的錯是寫成 wants be（兩個動詞直接連在一起）或 wants being（want 後面不能接 V-ing）。

items.prompt: My mom needs me ___ the dishes tonight.
items.explain: 這題是「need + 人 + to V」（需要某人去做某事）。線索是 needs 後面先出現受詞 me，接下來的動作就要用 to do。寫 do 少了 to；寫 doing 是把 need 和 enjoy、keep 那類動詞搞混了。

items.prompt: Jack decided {{1}} (become) a baseball player.
items.explain: decide（決定）後面接 to V，所以填 to become。線索是空格前的 decided。decided 已經表示過去了，to 後面永遠用原形，不可以寫 to became，也不能寫 becoming。

items.prompt: Amy visits her grandparents this weekend.
items.cue: 加入 plan（計畫），改寫成「Amy 計畫這個週末去看祖父母」。
answers: Amy (plans|is planning) to visit her grandparents this weekend.
items.explain: plan（計畫）後面接 to V。主詞 Amy 是第三人稱單數，plan 要加 s 變成 plans；原本的 visits 接在 to 後面要變回原形 visit。最常見的錯是寫成 plans to visits 或 plans visiting。

items.prompt: Dad asked me to watch TV.
items.cue: 加入 not，改寫成「爸爸要求我『不要』看電視」。
answers: Dad asked me not to watch TV.
items.explain: 「ask + 人 + to V」的否定是把 not 放在 to 的前面：asked me not to watch TV（要求我不要看電視）。很多人會寫成 didn't ask me to watch TV，那是「沒有要求我看電視」，意思不一樣。也不能寫 don't to watch。

items.prompt: ___ do you plan to do this weekend? I plan to go hiking.
items.explain: 回答是 I plan to go hiking（我打算去健行），說的是「做什麼事」，所以問句用 What。線索是問句最後的 to do 後面少了受詞，要用 What 來問。Where 問地點、When 問時間、Who 問人，都和回答對不上。

items.prompt: Emma enjoys ___ comic books.
items.explain: enjoy（喜歡、享受）後面只能接 V-ing，所以是 enjoys reading。線索是空格前的 enjoys。最常見的錯是選 to read，因為 like 可以接 to V，但 enjoy 不行。

items.prompt: The kids kept ___ in the classroom.
items.explain: keep（持續、一直）後面接 V-ing，kept talking 是「一直講話」。線索是空格前的 kept。kept 已經是過去式，後面不用再寫 talked；keep 後面也不能接 to talk。

items.prompt: Did you finish {{1}} (do) your homework?
items.explain: finish（完成）後面接 V-ing，所以是 finish doing your homework。線索是空格前的 finish。前面的 Did 管的是 finish（所以 finish 用原形），後面的 do 還是要變成 doing，不能寫 to do 或 do。

items.prompt: Judy practices ___ the piano every day.
items.explain: practice（練習）後面接 V-ing，所以是 practices playing the piano。線索是空格前的 practices。選 to play 是和 want、plan 那類動詞搞混；選 plays 則變成兩個動詞直接連在一起。

items.prompt: Tom likes to cook for his family.
items.cue: 把 likes 換成 enjoys，改寫句子（後面的動詞形式要跟著改）。
answers: Tom enjoys cooking for his family.
items.explain: like 後面可以接 to V 或 V-ing，但 enjoy 後面只能接 V-ing，所以 to cook 要改成 cooking。主詞 Tom 是單數，enjoy 要加 s。最常見的錯是只換動詞，寫成 enjoys to cook。

items.prompt: Remember ___ the door before you leave.
items.explain: remember to V 是「記得要去做」（事情還沒做）；remember V-ing 是「記得做過」（事情已經做了）。線索是 before you leave（離開之前）：門還沒鎖，是提醒對方要去鎖，所以用 to lock。選 locking 會變成「記得曾經鎖過門」，意思不通。

items.prompt: Lisa is good at ___ pictures.
items.explain: at 是介系詞，介系詞後面的動詞一律改成 V-ing，所以是 is good at drawing（擅長畫畫）。線索是空格前的 at。最常見的錯是寫 good at draw 或 good at to draw。

items.prompt: Thank you for {{1}} (help) me with my homework.
items.explain: for 是介系詞，後面的動詞要用 V-ing：Thank you for helping me（謝謝你幫我）。線索是空格前的 for。寫成 for help me 或 for to help me 都是錯的。

items.prompt: He goes to school after ___ breakfast.
items.explain: 這裡的 after 後面沒有主詞，是當介系詞用，所以動詞要改成 V-ing：after having breakfast（吃完早餐後）。如果要用 has，前面必須有主詞（after he has breakfast）。have 和 to have 都不能直接接在介系詞後面。

items.prompt: Mia is thinking about ___ a new job.
items.explain: think about（考慮）的 about 是介系詞，後面的動詞要用 V-ing：thinking about finding a new job。線索是空格前的 about。最常見的錯是選 to find，介系詞後面不能接 to V，也不能接原形。

items.prompt: My brother can fix bikes.
items.cue: 用 be good at 代替 can，改寫句子。
answers: My brother is good at fixing (bikes|bicycles).
items.explain: be good at（擅長）可以代替 can 表示「很會做某事」。主詞 My brother 是單數，be 動詞用 is；at 是介系詞，fix 要改成 fixing。最常見的錯是寫成 is good at fix bikes，或忘了寫 be 動詞。

items.prompt: She dreams of {{1}} (become) a famous singer one day.
items.explain: dream of（夢想）的 of 是介系詞，後面的動詞要用 V-ing，所以是 dreams of becoming。become 字尾有 e，要去 e 再加 ing。常見的錯是寫 of become 或 of to become。

items.prompt: ___ comic books is fun.
items.explain: 動詞不能直接當主詞，要改成動名詞（V-ing）：Reading comic books is fun（看漫畫很有趣）。線索是後面已經有動詞 is，所以空格是主詞的位置。Read 是原形、Reads 是動詞，都不能當主詞；To reading 把 to 和 V-ing 混在一起，沒有這種寫法。

items.prompt: Swimming in the river ___ dangerous.
items.explain: 一個動名詞片語當主詞時，把它當成「一件事」，動詞用單數 is。主詞是 Swimming in the river（在河裡游泳這件事）。不要因為字尾有 -ing 或覺得主詞很長就選 are；were 是過去式複數，也不對。

items.prompt: Singing and dancing ___ my favorite activities.
items.explain: 主詞是 Singing and dancing，用 and 連起來的兩件事，所以動詞用複數 are。另一個線索是後面的 activities 是複數。只有一個動名詞當主詞才用 is，這題最常錯選 is。

items.prompt: {{1}} (be) a doctor is not easy.
items.explain: 動詞要當主詞必須改成動名詞，be 的動名詞是 Being：Being a doctor is not easy（當醫生不容易）。線索是後面已經有動詞 is，空格是主詞的位置。不能直接寫 Be 或 Is；寫 To be 也算對，但課本比較常用 V-ing 開頭。

items.prompt: It is important to eat breakfast.
items.cue: 用動名詞（V-ing）開頭當主詞，改寫句子。
answers: Eating breakfast is important.
items.explain: 「It is + 形容詞 + to V」可以改成「V-ing + is + 形容詞」。把 to eat breakfast 改成 Eating breakfast 放到句首當主詞，原本的虛主詞 It 就不需要了。常見的錯是寫 Eat breakfast is important（原形不能當主詞），或把 It 留著。

items.prompt: It is great to have a dream.
items.cue: 用不定詞（To V）開頭當主詞，改寫句子。
answers: To have a dream is great.
items.explain: 不定詞（to V）也可以放在句首當主詞。把 to have a dream 整個搬到句首，To 要大寫，後面接 is great，虛主詞 It 拿掉。常見的錯是寫成 To having a dream（to 後面要用原形），或把 It 留著。

items.prompt: ___ is fun to play basketball with friends.
items.explain: 句子後面的 to play basketball with friends 才是真正的主詞，因為太長，所以句首用虛主詞 It 代替：It is fun to V。線索是「is + 形容詞 + to V」這個結構。This、That 不能當虛主詞；There is 是「有…」的意思，後面要接名詞。

items.prompt: It is not easy ___ a new language.
items.explain: It is + 形容詞 + to V：It is not easy to learn a new language。線索是句首的 It 和形容詞 easy，後面真正的主詞要用 to + 原形動詞。寫 learn 少了 to；寫 to learning 是把 to V 和 V-ing 混在一起。

items.prompt: It is kind ___ you to help the old man.
items.explain: kind、nice 這類形容詞是在稱讚「人」的個性，要用 of + 人：It is kind of you to...（你人真好…）。線索是形容詞 kind。如果形容詞是在說「事情」怎麼樣（easy、difficult、important），才用 for + 人，所以這題最常錯選 for。

items.prompt: It is difficult ___ me to get up early.
items.explain: difficult 是在說「早起」這件事很難，不是在形容人的個性，所以用 for + 人：It is difficult for me to get up early。線索是形容詞 difficult。of + 人只用在 kind、nice 這類稱讚人的形容詞後面。

items.prompt: Reading in bed is bad for your eyes.
items.cue: 用虛主詞 It 開頭，改寫句子。
answers: It is bad for your eyes to read in bed.
items.explain: 動名詞當主詞的句子可以改成「It is + 形容詞 + to V」。先寫 It is，把 bad for your eyes 照抄，最後把 Reading in bed 改成 to read in bed 放到句尾。常見的錯是 It 後面還留著 reading，或寫成 to reading（to 後面要用原形）。

items.prompt: It is important to use your phone in class.
items.cue: 加入 not，改寫成「上課『不要』用手機是很重要的」。
answers: It is important not to use your phone in class.
items.explain: 不定詞的否定是把 not 放在 to 的前面：not to use（不要使用）。所以是 It is important not to use your phone in class。如果寫成 It is not important to use...，意思會變成「用手機不重要」，和題目要的不一樣；也不能寫 don't to use。

items.prompt: Mr. Wang / wants / find a job
items.cue: 把這些字詞依序連成一個完整的句子，第二個動作要改成正確的形式。（例：Jessica / needs / drink some water → Jessica needs to drink some water.）
answers: Mr. Wang wants to find a job.
items.explain: want 後面接另一個動作要用 to V，所以在 wants 和 find 之間補上 to。主詞 Mr. Wang 是單數，wants 已經加了 s，to 後面的 find 維持原形。常見的錯是寫成 wants find 或 wants to finds。

items.prompt: Tom / hopes / become a successful engineer
items.cue: 把這些字詞依序連成一個完整的句子，第二個動作要改成正確的形式。（例：Jessica / needs / drink some water → Jessica needs to drink some water.）
answers: Tom hopes to become a successful engineer.
items.explain: hope（希望）後面接 to V，所以是 hopes to become。線索是動詞 hopes。to 後面用原形，不能寫 to becomes，也不能寫 hopes becoming。

items.prompt: Bill / wanted / me / mop the floor
items.cue: 把這些字詞依序連成一個完整的句子，第二個動作要改成正確的形式。（例：Jessica / needs / drink some water → Jessica needs to drink some water.）
answers: Bill wanted me to mop the floor.
items.explain: 「want + 人 + to V」表示想要某人去做某事。wanted 後面先放受詞 me，再接 to mop the floor。常見的錯是漏掉 to 寫成 wanted me mop，或因為 wanted 是過去式就寫 to mopped（to 後面永遠是原形）。

items.prompt: What country / does / Jack / plan / visit / this summer
items.cue: 把這些字詞依序連成一個完整的問句，第二個動作要改成正確的形式，句尾加問號。（例：Jessica / needs / drink some water → Jessica needs to drink some water.）
answers: What country does Jack plan to visit this summer?
items.explain: wh- 問句的順序是「疑問詞 + does + 主詞 + 原形動詞」，plan 後面的動作要用 to V，所以是 plan to visit。因為前面已經有 does，plan 不加 s。常見的錯是漏掉 to，或句尾忘了加問號。

items.prompt: Amy came from a poor family, so she ___ to go to work after high school.
items.explain: 空格後面是 to go，四個選項都是 decide 的變化，所以要判斷的是時態。線索是前半句的 came（過去式），整句在講過去的事，所以用 decided。decide 和 decides 是現在式；deciding 前面沒有 be 動詞，不能單獨當動詞。

items.zh: 我想要和她一起工作。
answers: I want to work with her.
items.explain: want 後面接 to V：I want to work with her。to 要放在 want 和 work 中間，不能漏掉。work with 是「和…一起工作」，後面接受格 her。

items.zh: 他們決定一起寫歌。
answers: They decided to write songs together.
items.explain: decide（決定）後面接 to V：They decided to write songs together。to 要放在 decided 和 write 中間，together（一起）放在句尾。常見的錯是把 together 放到 write songs 前面，或把 to 放錯位置。

items.zh: 甚至連那男孩的媽媽都要他放棄他的夢想，但他沒有。
answers: Even (the|that) boy's (mom|mother) wanted him to give up his dream, but he (didn't|did not) [give up].
items.explain: 「要某人做某事」是 want + 人 + to V：wanted him to give up his dream。「甚至連」用 Even 放句首；後半句「但他沒有」用 but he didn't，didn't 後面省略了 give up。常見的錯是漏掉 to 寫成 wanted him give up，或把受格 him 寫成 he。
items.cue: 用 want 和 give up。

items.prompt: The boss needs a secretary ___ the day for him.
items.explain: need + 人 + to V（需要某人去做某事）：needs a secretary to plan the day。線索是 needs 後面先有受詞 a secretary，後面的動作就用 to V。選 plans 是誤以為 secretary 是主詞；選 plan 少了 to。

items.prompt: Mom wanted ___ the homework before I played the game.
items.explain: want + 人（受格）+ to V：wanted me to do the homework。線索是動詞 wanted。me do 少了 to；my doing 和 I can do 都不能接在 want 後面，want 後面的人要用受格 me。

items.prompt: I study this evening.
items.cue: 加入 need，改寫成「我今天晚上需要讀書」。
answers: I need to study this evening.
items.explain: need（需要）後面接 to V，所以在 I 和 study 之間加上 need to：I need to study this evening。to 後面的 study 用原形。常見的錯是寫成 I need study（少了 to）或 I need studying。

items.prompt: Anita doesn't want ___ a factory worker like her sister.
items.explain: want 後面接 to V，be 動詞的不定詞是 to be，所以是 doesn't want to be a factory worker。只選 to 的話後面沒有動詞，句子不完整；只選 be 少了 to；being 是 V-ing，want 後面不能接。

items.prompt: Helen enjoyed being a mail carrier.
items.cue: 把 enjoyed 換成 planned，改寫句子（後面的動詞形式要跟著改）。
answers: Helen planned to (be|become) a mail carrier.
items.explain: enjoy 後面接 V-ing，但 plan 後面要接 to V，所以換成 planned 之後，being 要改成 to be。to 後面永遠用原形。最常見的錯是只換動詞，寫成 planned being。

items.zh: 媽媽要我持續練習足球。
answers: Mom wanted me to keep practicing soccer.
items.explain: 這句有兩個規則：want + 人 + to V，以及 keep + V-ing。所以是 wanted me to keep practicing soccer：to 後面用原形 keep，keep 後面再接 practicing。常見的錯是把 keep 和 practicing soccer 的順序放反。

items.zh: 那位記者決定放棄他的工作並成為一名農夫。
answers: (The|That) reporter decided to give up his job and [to] (become|be) a farmer.
items.explain: decide 後面接 to V：decided to give up his job。and 連接兩個動作時，第二個動作的 to 可以省略，所以 and become 或 and to become 都對，但 become 一定要用原形。常見的錯是受到 decided 影響寫成 and became。
items.cue: 用 decide 和 give up。

items.zh: John 的女兒需要他為她買一件夾克。
answers: John's daughter needs him to buy (a jacket for her|her a jacket).
items.explain: need + 人 + to V：needs him to buy...。「需要他」的他要用受格 him，不是 he；主詞 John's daughter 是單數，need 要加 s。「為她買一件夾克」可以寫 buy a jacket for her 或 buy her a jacket，但不能寫 buy a jacket to her。
items.cue: 用 need。

items.prompt: Ida: What do you plan ___ this weekend? Ed: Maybe visit my grandparents.
items.explain: plan（計畫）後面接 to V，所以是 What do you plan to do this weekend?（你這週末打算做什麼？）線索是空格前的 plan。寫 do 少了 to；plan 後面不接 V-ing，所以 doing 也不對。

items.prompt: A: Who does Ethan plan ___ lunch with? B: Nadia.
items.explain: plan 後面接 to V：plan to have lunch（打算吃午餐）。線索是空格前的 plan。雖然主詞 Ethan 是單數，但 to 後面永遠用原形，不能選 has；直接接 have 則少了 to。

items.prompt: Thomas kept ___ his hands.
items.explain: keep 後面接 V-ing，kept washing his hands 是「一直洗手」。線索是空格前的 kept。kept 已經是過去式，後面不必再用 washed；keep 後面也不接 to V。

items.prompt: I enjoy ___ with my family.
items.explain: enjoy 後面只能接 V-ing，be 動詞的 V-ing 是 being，所以是 I enjoy being with my family（我喜歡和家人在一起）。線索是空格前的 enjoy。選 to be 是和 want 搞混；am 和 be 不能直接接在另一個動詞後面。

items.prompt: The secretary stopped {{1}} (write) because his boss called him.
items.explain: stop + V-ing 是「停止正在做的事」。線索是 because his boss called him：老闆打電話來，所以他停下「寫字」這個動作，填 writing（write 去 e 加 ing）。如果寫 stopped to write，意思會變成「停下來去寫字」，和句意相反。

items.prompt: The fisherman is busy {{1}} (catch) fish at sea.
items.explain: be busy + V-ing 是「忙著做某事」，所以是 is busy catching fish。線索是空格前的 busy。這是固定用法，不能寫 busy to catch 或 busy catch。

items.prompt: When did you finish {{1}} (practice) the piano?（你何時練完琴的？）
items.explain: finish（完成）後面接 V-ing，所以是 finish practicing the piano（練完琴）。practice 字尾有 e，要去 e 再加 ing。前面的 did 管的是 finish，後面的動作還是要用 V-ing，不能寫 to practice 或 practice。

items.zh: Sherry 持續繪畫。
answers: Sherry (kept|keeps) [on] (painting|drawing).
items.explain: keep（持續）後面接 V-ing：kept painting（一直畫）。keep 的過去式是不規則的 kept，不是 keeped；如果用現在式，主詞 Sherry 是單數，要寫 keeps。最常見的錯是寫成 kept to paint 或 kept paint。
items.cue: 用 keep。

items.prompt: Joan practices ___ the guitar with her sister every night.
items.explain: practice 後面接 V-ing：practices playing the guitar。線索是空格前的 practices。to play 是最常選錯的答案，要記住 practice 和 enjoy、keep、finish 是同一類，後面只接 V-ing。

items.prompt: Dad likes to watch TV after work.
items.cue: 把 likes 換成 enjoys，改寫句子（後面的動詞形式要跟著改）。
answers: Dad enjoys watching TV after work.
items.explain: enjoy 後面只能接 V-ing，所以 to watch 要改成 watching。主詞 Dad 是單數，enjoy 要加 s 變成 enjoys。最常見的錯是只換動詞，寫成 enjoys to watch TV。

items.prompt: The teacher was mad because some students kept ___ their phones.
items.explain: keep 後面接 V-ing：kept looking at their phones（一直看手機）。線索是空格前的 kept。不要因為 kept 是過去式就選 looked at；keep 後面也不接 to V 或原形。

items.prompt: Yuki ___ to talk about her idea in front of her class.
items.explain: 線索是空格後面的 to talk（to V）。keep、enjoy、finish 後面都只能接 V-ing，只有 hate（討厭）後面可以接 to V（也可以接 V-ing），所以答案是 hates。這題是反過來考：看後面的形式來決定前面用哪個動詞。

items.prompt: I finished the history report at half past three.
items.cue: 在 finished 後面加入動詞 write（要改成正確的形式），改寫句子。
answers: I finished writing the history report at half past three.
items.explain: finish 後面接 V-ing，所以加入的 write 要改成 writing：finished writing the history report。write 字尾有 e，要去 e 再加 ing，不是 writeing。常見的錯是寫成 finished to write 或 finished wrote。

items.zh: Jimmy 是個卡車司機。他很享受開車。
answers: Jimmy is a truck driver. He [really] enjoys driving [((very|so) much|a lot)].
items.explain: enjoy 後面接 V-ing：He enjoys driving。主詞 He 是第三人稱單數，enjoy 要加 s；drive 要去 e 再加 ing。最常見的錯是寫成 enjoys to drive 或 enjoys drive。
items.cue: 用 enjoy。

items.prompt: Selena: The baby keeps ___. Chris: Maybe she's hungry.
items.explain: keep 後面接 V-ing：The baby keeps crying（寶寶一直哭）。線索是空格前的 keeps。keeps 已經加過 s 了，後面不能再接 cries；也不能接 to cry 或原形 cry。

items.prompt: My father never gives up ___ in my dream.
items.explain: give up（放棄）後面接名詞或 V-ing，不能接原形動詞或 to V。線索是空格前的 gives up：never gives up believing in my dream 是「從不放棄相信我的夢想」。最常錯選 to believe。

items.prompt: Remember ___ the dishes.（記得要洗碗盤。）
items.explain: remember to V 是「記得要去做」（還沒做），remember V-ing 是「記得做過」（已經做了）。線索是中文「記得要洗碗盤」：碗還沒洗，所以用 to wash。選 washing 會變成「記得洗過碗」。

items.prompt: Thank you for {{1}} (help) me.
items.explain: for 是介系詞，介系詞後面的動詞要用 V-ing：Thank you for helping me。線索是空格前的 for。寫 for help me 或 for to help me 都是錯的。

items.prompt: My kids are terrible at {{1}} (play) basketball.
items.explain: be terrible at 是「很不擅長」，和 be good at 用法一樣。at 是介系詞，後面的動詞要改成 V-ing：terrible at playing basketball。常見的錯是寫 at play 或 at to play。

items.prompt: What do you think of {{1}} (join) the science club next year?
items.explain: think of 的 of 是介系詞，後面的動詞要用 V-ing：think of joining the science club。線索是空格前的 of。What do you think of + V-ing? 是在問「你覺得做…怎麼樣？」，不能寫 of join 或 of to join。

items.prompt: I'm dreaming about {{1}} (travel) around the world one day.
items.explain: dream about（夢想）的 about 是介系詞，後面的動詞要用 V-ing：dreaming about traveling。線索是空格前的 about。traveling 和 travelling 兩種拼法都對；寫 about travel 或 about to travel 是錯的。

items.zh: 我擅長畫畫，但我不擅長寫作。
answers: I am good at (drawing [pictures]|painting), but I am (not good|bad|poor) at writing.
items.explain: be good at + V-ing 是「擅長做某事」，at 是介系詞，所以 draw 和 write 都要改成 V-ing（write 要去 e）。否定是在 be 動詞後面加 not：I am not good at writing。常見的錯是寫 good at draw，或漏掉 be 動詞寫成 I good at。

items.zh: Lucy 正在考慮採訪那位有名的歌手。
answers: (Lucy is|Lucy's) thinking (about|of) interviewing (the|that) famous singer.
(Lucy is|Lucy's) considering interviewing (the|that) famous singer.
items.explain: 「正在考慮」用現在進行式 is thinking about（或 of）。about 和 of 是介系詞，後面的 interview 要改成 interviewing。常見的錯是寫成 thinking about to interview 或 thinking about interview。
items.cue: 用 think about 或 think of。

items.prompt: Amy is good at ___, and it was always her dream to open a bakery.
items.explain: be good at 的 at 是介系詞，後面要接 V-ing：is good at baking（擅長烘焙），bake 要去 e 再加 ing。線索是空格前的 at。to bake 是最常選錯的答案，介系詞後面不能接 to V。

items.zh: 除了唱歌，我的姊姊還會彈鋼琴。
answers: Besides singing, my [(older|big|elder)] sister can [also] play the piano.
items.explain: besides（除了…之外還）是介系詞，後面的動詞要用 V-ing：Besides singing。逗號後面再寫完整的句子，can 後面用原形 play。常見的錯是寫成 Besides sing，或把 besides 寫成 beside（在…旁邊）。
items.cue: 用 Besides 開頭。

items.prompt: They worry about ___ enough money for the trip.
items.explain: about 是介系詞，後面要接 V-ing；V-ing 的否定是在前面加 not，所以是 worry about not having enough money（擔心沒有足夠的錢）。not have 和 have no 用了原形，doesn't have 是完整的動詞，都不能接在介系詞後面。

items.prompt: Jane can play the violin.
items.cue: 用 be good at 代替 can，改寫句子。
answers: Jane is good at playing the violin.
items.explain: be good at 可以代替 can 表示「很會做某事」。主詞 Jane 是單數，be 動詞用 is；at 是介系詞，play 要改成 playing。常見的錯是寫成 is good at play the violin，或漏掉 is。

items.prompt: Darren often eats out because his mom isn't good ___ cooking.
items.explain: 「擅長」的固定用法是 be good at，後面接名詞或 V-ing：isn't good at cooking（不擅長煮飯）。線索是 good 和後面的 cooking。be good for 是「對…有好處」，be good with 是「很會應付（人或東西）」，意思都不對。

items.prompt: Tony is thinking about it.
items.cue: 把 it 換成 grow some fruit on the farm（動詞要改成正確的形式），改寫句子。
answers: Tony is thinking about growing some fruit on the farm.
items.explain: about 是介系詞，後面如果放動作，動詞要改成 V-ing。所以把 it 換成 growing some fruit on the farm，grow 直接加 ing。常見的錯是直接照抄寫成 thinking about grow，或寫 about to grow。

items.prompt: Ivy: What are you thinking? Ben: I'm thinking about ___ the front door red.
items.explain: think about 的 about 是介系詞，後面的動詞要用 V-ing：thinking about painting the front door red（考慮把前門漆成紅色）。線索是空格前的 about。to paint 是最常選錯的答案，介系詞後面不接 to V。

items.prompt: Ricky is good at ___ the violin and the piano.
items.explain: be good at 的 at 是介系詞，後面的動詞要用 V-ing：is good at playing。線索是空格前的 at。不要因為主詞 Ricky 是單數就選 plays，這句的動詞是 is，at 後面只能放 V-ing。

items.zh: Jessie 從未放棄她成為歌手的夢想。
answers: Jessie never (gave|gives) up her dream of (becoming|being) a singer.
Jessie has never given up her dream of (becoming|being) a singer.
items.explain: 「成為歌手的夢想」是 dream of + V-ing：her dream of becoming a singer。of 是介系詞，所以 become 要去 e 加 ing。「從未放棄」是 never gave up，give 的過去式是 gave。常見的錯是寫成 dream of become，或 dream of to become。
items.cue: 用 give up 和 dream of。

items.prompt: ___ to bed late is bad for our health.
items.explain: 動詞當主詞要改成動名詞：Going to bed late is bad for our health（晚睡對健康不好）。線索是後面已經有動詞 is，所以句首是主詞的位置。Go、Goes、Went 都是動詞，不能直接當主詞。

items.prompt: Flying a kite ___ fun for me.
items.explain: 主詞是 Flying a kite（放風箏這件事），一個動名詞片語當主詞算單數，所以用 is。不要看到後面的 me 就選 am，am 只能配主詞 I；主詞只有一件事，也不能用 are。

items.prompt: Reading and writing ___ important for students in school.
items.explain: 主詞是 Reading and writing，用 and 連起來的兩件事，動詞要用複數 are。只有一個動名詞當主詞才用 is，這題最常錯選 is。was 是過去式單數，句子在講一般的事實，也不對。

items.zh: 當一位記者是那女孩夢想的工作。
answers: (Being|To be|Becoming|To become) a reporter is (the|that) girl's dream job.
items.explain: 「當一位記者」是主詞，動詞要改成動名詞 Being a reporter（寫 To be a reporter 也可以），後面接單數動詞 is。「那女孩夢想的工作」是 the girl's dream job，girl 後面要加 's。常見的錯是直接用原形 Be a reporter 開頭。

items.prompt: Working in a factory and fixing cars ___ not easy for most people.
items.explain: 主詞是 Working in a factory 和 fixing cars 兩件事，用 and 連起來，所以動詞用複數 are。線索是中間的 and。be 和 being 不能單獨當句子的動詞；can 後面要接原形動詞，不能直接接 not easy。

items.prompt: It is interesting to interview famous people.
items.cue: 用動名詞（V-ing）開頭當主詞，改寫句子。
answers: Interviewing famous people is interesting.
items.explain: 「It is + 形容詞 + to V」可以改成「V-ing + is + 形容詞」。把 to interview famous people 改成 Interviewing famous people 放到句首，後面接 is interesting，It 拿掉。常見的錯是用原形 Interview 開頭，或因為 people 是複數而寫成 are（主詞是「採訪」這件事，算單數）。

items.prompt: It is great for us to join the party.
items.cue: 用不定詞（To V）開頭當主詞，改寫句子。
answers: To join the party is great for us.
items.explain: 把真正的主詞 to join the party 搬到句首，To 大寫，後面接 is great for us，虛主詞 It 拿掉。不定詞當主詞算單數，動詞用 is。常見的錯是寫成 To joining the party，或把 for us 漏掉。

items.zh: 規劃你的未來很重要。
answers: Planning [for] your future is [very] important.
items.explain: 「規劃你的未來」是一件事，當主詞時動詞要改成動名詞：Planning your future。plan 要重複字尾 n 再加 ing。動名詞當主詞算單數，動詞用 is；不能直接用原形 Plan 開頭。
items.cue: 用動名詞（V-ing）開頭。

items.prompt: ___ an office worker is not Shirley's dream job.
items.explain: 線索是後面已經有動詞 is，所以句首需要一個能當主詞的形式。be 的動名詞 Being 可以當主詞：Being an office worker is not...。Be 和 Can be 是動詞，不能當主詞；It's 裡面已經有 is，會和後面的 is 重複。

items.prompt: ___ a world famous piano player before I am thirty is my dream.
